title: Database Reliability Engineer - DBRE
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Database Reliability Engineer - DBRE em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Estamos em busca de um(a) DBRE (Database Reliability Engineer) para atuar em um ambiente orientado por Data Mesh , com foco em resiliência, automação e governança de dados distribuídos . Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, performance e escalabilidade dos bancos de dados utilizados pelas equipes de produto e engenharia.


Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar e implementar estratégias de confiabilidade para bancos de dados em domínios distribuídos.
  • Automatizar processos de provisionamento, backup, monitoramento e recuperação de bancos de dados.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os times de produto e engenharia para garantir boas práticas de modelagem e performance.
  • Atuar na observabilidade e rastreabilidade dos dados em ambientes SQL e NoSQL.
  • Participar da definição de padrões e políticas de governança de dados dentro da arquitetura Data Mesh.
  • Realizar troubleshooting e tuning de queries e estruturas de dados.
  • Gerenciar e otimizar recursos de banco de dados em AWS , utilizando serviços como RDS, Aurora, EC2, S3, CloudWatch, IAM e Secrets Manager .


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência avançada com SQL Server , PostgreSQL e MongoDB .
  • Domínio de AWS , especialmente em serviços voltados para bancos de dados e infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC) com Terraform ou CloudFormation .
  • Automação com PowerShell, Bash ou Python .
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura orientada a domínios (DDD) e Data Mesh .
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD e integração com pipelines de dados.
  • Experiência com ambientes cloud-native e containers (Docker, Kubernetes) .


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.

title: Key Account Manager / Presales Lead
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Key Account Manager / Presales Lead em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About WorkPacks: Nestled in the vibrant tech ecosystem of the USA, WorkPacks is an innovative startup reshaping the construction industry's future. We're in search of daring individuals who are eager to disrupt, envision, and build anew. As trailblazers in the digital arena, we're stretching the limits of what's possible and warmly invite you to embark on this exhilarating venture with us.


Position Overview: We’re looking for a motivated Key Account Manager / Implementation Lead who will serve as both a relationship builder and implementation expert. In this role, you’ll be the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring our software solutions align with their needs and integrate seamlessly into their operations. This fully remote role combines client engagement with hands-on deployment, offering the opportunity to be directly involved in both client satisfaction and product success.


Responsibilities:


  • Client Relationship Management: Cultivate strong, lasting relationships with key clients, ensuring they feel supported and valued.
  • Primary Point of Contact: Serve as the primary liaison for assigned accounts, providing responsive and reliable client support.
  • Implementation Planning: Develop, document, and manage comprehensive implementation plans, including client-specific requirements, configurations, and any necessary customizations.
  • Data Specification Documentation: Prepare technical specifications and manage electronic data interface (EDI) setup with clients for seamless integration.
  • Deployment Leadership: Lead software implementations at client locations as required, managing deployment to ensure successful integration and operation.
  • Client Collaboration: Work closely with clients to thoroughly understand their project requirements and guarantee successful software adoption.
  • Technical Support & Troubleshooting: Deliver hands-on technical support during the implementation phase, addressing issues quickly to maintain satisfaction.
  • Client Training: Educate clients and their teams on using our software effectively, enabling them to gain maximum benefit from the tools.
  • Feedback Loop with Development: Collaborate closely with the product development team, sharing field insights and client feedback to support ongoing product improvements.


Qualifications:


  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
  • Industry Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in the construction industry.
  • Technical Interest: Strong interest in construction technology and software solutions.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills for effective client engagement and support.
  • Problem-Solving Abilities: A detail-oriented approach with a proactive problem-solving mindset.
  • Multi-Project Management: Capability to manage multiple client accounts or projects simultaneously.
  • Willingness to Travel: Availability to travel to client sites as necessary.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Advanced Work Packaging (AWP): Familiarity with AWP methodologies.
  • Software Knowledge: Experience with construction management software or related technology.
  • Implementation Process Insight: Basic understanding of software implementation processes.
  • Client-Facing Experience: Previous experience in a client-focused role or account management.


Expectations


  • Remote Work: Fully remote position with flexibility and some overlap required with U.S. working hours.
  • Autonomous Drive: Proactive, creative, and capable of driving projects forward independently.
  • Hands-on Approach: Eager to engage with both client challenges and technical solutions directly.


Compensation:

  • Salary: Competitive salary starting at $55,000/year.
  • Benefits: Comprehensive health and wellness benefits.
  • Growth Opportunities: Paths for professional development and career advancement within the company.
  • Culture: A collaborative, inclusive, and innovation-driven workplace that values teamwork and individual initiative.


This role is perfect for a client-focused, tech-savvy professional passionate about transforming the construction industry through technology. Join us to shape the future of construction, drive client success, and take the lead in groundbreaking software implementations!

title: Junior Technical Support Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Junior Technical Support Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Junior Customer Support Analyst (Technical Support)


About the Opportunity

We are looking for a Customer Support Specialist to join a global technology team supporting innovative digital products and platforms.

This is a long-term remote opportunity for professionals based in Brazil who enjoy solving problems, helping customers, and working closely with product and engineering teams in a fast-paced environment.

The ideal candidate combines strong customer service skills with technical curiosity and the ability to troubleshoot software-related issues.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customer support inquiries.
  • Capture and document critical issue details within the ticketing system.
  • Troubleshoot software and platform-related issues through investigation and testing.
  • Guide customers through troubleshooting steps and identify whether issues are technical defects or user knowledge gaps.
  • Maintain clear and professional communication with customers throughout the resolution process.
  • Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering teams to escalate and resolve complex issues.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of support processes and knowledge base documentation.
  • Assist in monitoring service levels and support performance metrics.
  • Identify recurring issues and recommend process or product improvements.


Required Qualifications

  • 1+ year of experience in Customer Support, Customer Service, Technical Support, Help Desk, Service Desk, or similar roles.
  • Experience working with ticketing systems.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written communication skills.
  • Ability to explain technical concepts in a simple and customer-friendly manner.
  • Experience supporting a high volume of customer inquiries.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Professional English communication skills (written and verbal).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting SaaS products or technology platforms.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Intercom, or similar support tools.
  • Experience collaborating with software engineering or product teams.
  • Previous experience creating support documentation or knowledge base articles.
  • Leadership or customer service management experience is a plus.


What We're Looking For

  • Customer-first mindset.
  • Empathy and strong communication skills.
  • Curiosity and passion for technology.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Continuous learning mentality.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability.


Work Environment

  • 100% Remote (Brazil)
  • Long-term project | PJ
  • International team environment
  • Schedule aligned with U.S. Central Time (CST)

title: Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Salary - 120,898 BRL Annually

Fully Remote

Start Date - ASAP, need immediate joiners


Must Haves:

Enterprise PM experience: 2–4+ years managing large, high-risk IT projects (data, infrastructure, or application development) in global environments

Strong, assertive PM leadership: Proactive “activist” PM who can drive projects forward, make tough decisions, and push back when needed

Proven experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe preferred), with flexibility to work across Scrum, Kanban, and hybrid environments

Full lifecycle ownership: Ability to manage scope, timelines, budgets, and cross-functional teams across multiple concurrent projects (often 3–4 at a time)

Strong communication & stakeholder management: Confident interacting across all levels, building relationships, driving accountability, and facilitating Agile ceremonies

Bilingual (English, Spanish, Portugues)

Financial background

Nice to Haves:

Certifications: PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe Scrum Master, CSM/PSM, or other Agile certifications

Tools & platforms: Experience with Jira, ServiceNow, PowerBI, and collaboration tools like Miro/whiteboarding tools

Technical breadth: Exposure to both cloud and on-prem IT initiatives

Change management experience: Background in organizational change, adoption strategies, or transformation initiatives

Day to Day:

A client of Insight Global is seeking a Project Manager to join their team remotely. This individual will manage 3–4 concurrent enterprise IT projects across data, infrastructure, and application development. Day-to-day, they will drive delivery across Agile/Scrum, SAFe, and hybrid teams, lead standups and stakeholder updates, track budgets and timelines, and ensure scope alignment. They will proactively mitigate risks, enforce accountability, and communicate effectively across global teams in English and Spanish/Portuguese.

title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that helps companies scale their teams on demand.


A Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert is needed to design, build, launch, and optimize email, messaging, segmentation, and automation solutions. This role will support critical marketing technology initiatives, guide junior developers, and act as a module lead or point of contact for one or more markets or countries.


The role involves working across email development, journey orchestration, audience segmentation, reporting, and platform process improvements.

The expert will work with geographically distributed teams, including developers, project managers, and market stakeholders. Key objectives include improving campaign execution, maintaining reliable system processes, supporting new proof-of-concept initiatives, and identifying trends or issues that can inform future marketing decisions.


Task and deliverables:

  • Build, launch, and monitor email campaigns, messages, journeys, and audience segmentation within Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
  • Implement and support the full lifecycle of email and messaging initiatives, from development through testing, deployment, reporting, and optimization.
  • Develop reusable email templates, content assets, and campaign components using HTML, CSS, AMPscript, SSJS, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud tools.
  • Create and maintain audience segments, automations, and data-driven campaign logic using SQL and relevant SFMC modules.
  • Generate, review, and interpret email performance reports to identify trends, issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Support campaign asset development, including selecting or adapting imagery and content elements that improve audience response.
  • Guide junior developers on Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities, standards, and best practices.
  • Act as module lead and point of contact for one or more markets or countries.
  • Document system processes, recurring issues, campaign workflows, and technical recommendations for the project team.
  • Develop and support proof-of-concept initiatives for new Salesforce Marketing Cloud solutions and enhancements.


Required experience:

  • Required: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Required: 6–7+ years of IT experience, including 3–4+ years of hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience.
  • Required: Strong knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud and core email marketing, messaging, segmentation, and automation concepts.
  • Required: Experience with at least three Salesforce Marketing Cloud modules, such as Email Studio, Journey Builder, Mobile Studio, Contact Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Advertising Studio, SQL, or audience creation.
  • Required: Experience writing moderately complex SQL queries for segmentation, reporting, or automation use cases.
  • Required: Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, AMPscript, and SSJS for email and campaign development.
  • Required: Strong attention to detail and experience with email testing, quality assurance, and deployment validation.
  • Required: Understanding of Salesforce best practices for marketing automation, data management, campaign execution, and platform governance.
  • Required: Ability to work independently with a high degree of ownership in a geographically distributed team.
  • Required: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Nice to have: Experience acting as a module lead, market lead, country point of contact, or technical owner for Salesforce Marketing Cloud workstreams.
  • Nice to have: Experience supporting proofs of concept or implementing new marketing technology solutions.


Engagement highlights:

  • Opportunity to lead Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities across one or more markets or countries.
  • Hands-on role covering campaign development, automation, reporting, optimization, and new solution design.
  • Collaborative environment with distributed development, project management, and business stakeholder teams.

title: Remote Mathematics Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Mathematics Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Mathematical Systems & Abstract Reasoning Engineer is responsible for developing advanced reasoning datasets that evaluate and improve the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role involves designing novel mathematical systems, defining custom rules and axioms, and creating rigorous reasoning challenges that require models to interpret definitions, perform symbolic computations, derive properties, and construct logically sound proofs. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in abstract mathematics with exceptional analytical and communication skills to produce self-contained, verifiable, and high-quality evaluation tasks.

What does day-to-day look like:

  • PhD / Doctorate
  • Designed and defined novel mathematical systems, operations, and axiomatic frameworks for reasoning evaluations.
  • Authored multi-step reasoning tasks involving symbolic manipulation, expression evaluation, and proof-based problem solving.
  • Developed deterministic solutions, detailed reasoning traces, and comprehensive scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Identified and addressed edge cases, ambiguities, and logical inconsistencies to ensure task robustness and reproducibility.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and AI/LLM teams to refine task definitions, evaluation criteria, and dataset quality standards.


Required Qualifications:

  • Strong foundation in abstract mathematics, formal logic, algebraic structures, discrete mathematics, or theoretical computer science.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in mathematics, computer science, data science, logic, or a related analytical discipline.
  • Proven ability to create structured reasoning problems that assess both conceptual understanding and procedural accuracy.
  • Excellent written communication skills with the ability to document rigorous definitions, proofs, and reasoning processes.
  • Experience evaluating LLM reasoning performance or developing AI training and assessment datasets is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

title: Staffing Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Staffing Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.



What the Platform Team Does at MAVI


Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service.


About the Role


We’re hiring a Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows.



What You'll Do


  • Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for MAVI customers , build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated.
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs.
  • Support the end-to-end matching process by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions.
  • Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities.
  • Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers.
  • Provide support throughout the hiring process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving.
  • Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties.
  • Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes.


What We’re Looking For


  • At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role.
  • Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, is a must.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, and customer relationships in a dynamic environment.
  • Proven ability to work in high-speed environments, to operate with high urgency, and be extremely customer-centric.
  • High level of discretion and judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information.
  • Experience working with global clients or in remote-first environments.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to change.
  • Exceptional communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic approach.
  • Someone who is humble, hungry and best in class at what they do.


Why You Should Join


  • Impact: You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.
  • No Bureaucracy: Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness.
  • Competitive Pay: We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it :)
  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.


Equal Opportunity Statement


At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Remote Mathematics Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Mathematics Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Mathematical Systems & Abstract Reasoning Engineer is responsible for developing advanced reasoning datasets that evaluate and improve the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role involves designing novel mathematical systems, defining custom rules and axioms, and creating rigorous reasoning challenges that require models to interpret definitions, perform symbolic computations, derive properties, and construct logically sound proofs. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in abstract mathematics with exceptional analytical and communication skills to produce self-contained, verifiable, and high-quality evaluation tasks.

What does day-to-day look like:

  • PhD / Doctorate
  • Designed and defined novel mathematical systems, operations, and axiomatic frameworks for reasoning evaluations.
  • Authored multi-step reasoning tasks involving symbolic manipulation, expression evaluation, and proof-based problem solving.
  • Developed deterministic solutions, detailed reasoning traces, and comprehensive scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Identified and addressed edge cases, ambiguities, and logical inconsistencies to ensure task robustness and reproducibility.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and AI/LLM teams to refine task definitions, evaluation criteria, and dataset quality standards.


Required Qualifications:

  • Strong foundation in abstract mathematics, formal logic, algebraic structures, discrete mathematics, or theoretical computer science.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in mathematics, computer science, data science, logic, or a related analytical discipline.
  • Proven ability to create structured reasoning problems that assess both conceptual understanding and procedural accuracy.
  • Excellent written communication skills with the ability to document rigorous definitions, proofs, and reasoning processes.
  • Experience evaluating LLM reasoning performance or developing AI training and assessment datasets is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

title: Staffing Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Staffing Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.



What the Platform Team Does at MAVI


Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service.


About the Role


We’re hiring a Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows.



What You'll Do


  • Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for MAVI customers , build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated.
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs.
  • Support the end-to-end matching process by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions.
  • Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities.
  • Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers.
  • Provide support throughout the hiring process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving.
  • Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties.
  • Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes.


What We’re Looking For


  • At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role.
  • Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, is a must.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, and customer relationships in a dynamic environment.
  • Proven ability to work in high-speed environments, to operate with high urgency, and be extremely customer-centric.
  • High level of discretion and judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information.
  • Experience working with global clients or in remote-first environments.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to change.
  • Exceptional communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic approach.
  • Someone who is humble, hungry and best in class at what they do.


Why You Should Join


  • Impact: You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.
  • No Bureaucracy: Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness.
  • Competitive Pay: We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it :)
  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.


Equal Opportunity Statement


At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Webflow Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Webflow Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job description


BX Studio, a leading Webflow design-and-development agency, is looking for an experienced Senior Webflow Developer to own and elevate our most complex web projects. You’ll collaborate closely with designers, strategists, and junior developers to deliver pixel-perfect, high-performance sites—on time, on budget, and at the cutting edge of Webflow’s capabilities. Fluency in English and a friendly, professional demeanor are essential.


What you’ll do

  • Lead builds end-to-end—from scoping and wireframes to launch and post-launch optimizations.
  • Architect scalable Webflow systems (components, class structures, CMS schema) using Client-First or similar methodologies.
  • Mentor and review junior developers, establishing best practices for accessibility, performance, and responsive design.
  • Implement advanced features such as memberships, logic flows, complex animations, e-commerce, API and Zapier/Make integrations, and custom code embeds.
  • Translate design files (Figma/Sketch/Adobe XD) into production-ready Webflow sites with perfect fidelity and micro-interaction polish.
  • Optimize SEO, page speed, and analytics, ensuring Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals targets are met.
  • Interface directly with clients and internal stakeholders, providing technical guidance, accurate estimates, and proactive solutions.
  • Continuously improve our workflow, researching new Webflow releases, no-code tools, and automation to keep BX Studio at the forefront of the industry.


Role requirements

  • 3+ years of professional Webflow development (or 6+ years front-end with 3+ in Webflow).
  • Demonstrated portfolio of complex, high-traffic Webflow sites—including CMS, e-commerce, and custom interactions.
  • Expert-level understanding of Client-First nomenclature and component libraries (Relume, Flowbase, etc.).
  • Proficiency with HTML5, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript (ES6+), and REST/GraphQL APIs; comfortable writing custom code when Webflow’s native tools aren’t enough.
  • Sharp eye for detail and commitment to pixel-perfect execution across breakpoints and browsers.
  • Leadership and mentorship experience—able to set code standards, run code reviews, and upskill teammates.
  • Strong project-management skills: accurate scoping, clear documentation, and a track record of hitting deadlines.
  • High degree of reliability, initiative, and integrity in a fully remote environment.
  • Availability to work core hours in either EST or PST time zones.

title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that helps companies scale their teams on demand.


A Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert is needed to design, build, launch, and optimize email, messaging, segmentation, and automation solutions. This role will support critical marketing technology initiatives, guide junior developers, and act as a module lead or point of contact for one or more markets or countries.


The role involves working across email development, journey orchestration, audience segmentation, reporting, and platform process improvements.

The expert will work with geographically distributed teams, including developers, project managers, and market stakeholders. Key objectives include improving campaign execution, maintaining reliable system processes, supporting new proof-of-concept initiatives, and identifying trends or issues that can inform future marketing decisions.


Task and deliverables:

  • Build, launch, and monitor email campaigns, messages, journeys, and audience segmentation within Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
  • Implement and support the full lifecycle of email and messaging initiatives, from development through testing, deployment, reporting, and optimization.
  • Develop reusable email templates, content assets, and campaign components using HTML, CSS, AMPscript, SSJS, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud tools.
  • Create and maintain audience segments, automations, and data-driven campaign logic using SQL and relevant SFMC modules.
  • Generate, review, and interpret email performance reports to identify trends, issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Support campaign asset development, including selecting or adapting imagery and content elements that improve audience response.
  • Guide junior developers on Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities, standards, and best practices.
  • Act as module lead and point of contact for one or more markets or countries.
  • Document system processes, recurring issues, campaign workflows, and technical recommendations for the project team.
  • Develop and support proof-of-concept initiatives for new Salesforce Marketing Cloud solutions and enhancements.


Required experience:

  • Required: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Required: 6–7+ years of IT experience, including 3–4+ years of hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience.
  • Required: Strong knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud and core email marketing, messaging, segmentation, and automation concepts.
  • Required: Experience with at least three Salesforce Marketing Cloud modules, such as Email Studio, Journey Builder, Mobile Studio, Contact Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Advertising Studio, SQL, or audience creation.
  • Required: Experience writing moderately complex SQL queries for segmentation, reporting, or automation use cases.
  • Required: Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, AMPscript, and SSJS for email and campaign development.
  • Required: Strong attention to detail and experience with email testing, quality assurance, and deployment validation.
  • Required: Understanding of Salesforce best practices for marketing automation, data management, campaign execution, and platform governance.
  • Required: Ability to work independently with a high degree of ownership in a geographically distributed team.
  • Required: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Nice to have: Experience acting as a module lead, market lead, country point of contact, or technical owner for Salesforce Marketing Cloud workstreams.
  • Nice to have: Experience supporting proofs of concept or implementing new marketing technology solutions.


Engagement highlights:

  • Opportunity to lead Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities across one or more markets or countries.
  • Hands-on role covering campaign development, automation, reporting, optimization, and new solution design.
  • Collaborative environment with distributed development, project management, and business stakeholder teams.

Salvador/BA | Presencial | CLT


Mais do que reabilitar, nós devolvemos conexões. ✨


Na Sonora Centro Auditivo, acreditamos que ouvir bem é viver melhor.

Todos os dias ajudamos pessoas a voltarem a participar das conversas em família, recuperarem sua autonomia e reconquistarem a confiança para se comunicar.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de inglês em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Junte-se à nossa equipe como professor de inglês remoto!

Na Flyover Idiomas, nosso diferencial está no processo de junção de alunos e professores, que visa aproveitar suas semelhanças, incluindo experiência e personalidade.

Estamos à procura de pessoas dedicadas e entusiasmadas para se juntarem à nossa equipe como professores de inglês remoto. Esta posição oferece a conveniência de trabalhar de qualquer lugar com horários flexíveis.


Sobre nós:  Somos uma escola de idiomas online comprometida em oferecer ensino de inglês de alta qualidade para alunos de todas as idades e contextos. Nossa missão é ensinar os alunos através de experiências de aprendizagem personalizadas, utilizando a abordagem comunicativa, com foco na fluência mais do que na precisão, selecionando materiais autênticos e relevantes, e integrando todas as quatro habilidades.


Visão geral da posição

  • Lecionar aulas de inglês, principalmente particulares ou em pequenos grupos.
  • Desenvolver planos de aula e atividades envolventes que atendam a diferentes necessidades de aprendizagem e níveis de proficiência, usando a abordagem comunicativa, focada na autonomia do aluno e na personalização da aula.
  • Participar de treinamentos, reuniões com nossos coordenadores e projetos diversos.
  • Fornecer feedback construtivo e ajudar os alunos a melhorar suas habilidades linguísticas.
  • Enviar relatórios das aulas para manter seus alunos e a escola atualizados sobre o andamento das mesmas.
  • Promover um ambiente de aprendizagem confortável e encorajador com foco no sucesso do alu no.


Formato

  • Contratação: Contrato com Microempreendedor Individual (MEI)
  • Local : Remoto
  • Carga Horária: Você define a sua própria agenda


Requisitos

  • Proficiência em inglês (mínimo C1)
  • Bacharel em Inglês, Educação, Linguística ou áreas similares (certificação TESOL/TEFL é um diferencial).
  • Experiência comprovada no ensino de inglês como segunda língua, seja online ou em sala de aula.
  • Disponibilidade de pelo menos 25 horas/semana, com alguns horários após as 17h (horário de São Paulo).
  • Habilidades de comunicação e de relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Conexão de internet estável, computador, webcam, espaço de trabalho privado e silencioso.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de ensino online.
  • CNPJ / MEI ativo.


Por que se juntar à nós?

  • Flexibilidade: Trabalhe de qualquer lugar com um horário flexível que se adapte ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Impacto: Fazer a diferença na vida dos alunos, ajudando-os a atingir seus objetivos de aprendizagem.
  • Crescimento Profissional: Acesso a oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades de ensino.
  • Comunidade de Apoio: Junte-se a uma equipe de educadores que se dedicam ao sucesso dos alunos e à melhoria contínua.

title: Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst para atuar na estruturação, evolução e governança do framework de indicadores de performance de serviços de Tecnologia da Informação, em ambiente corporativo de grande porte.

Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a consistência, padronização e confiabilidade dos indicadores utilizados na gestão de performance de serviços de TI, atuando de forma estratégica na definição e evolução de métricas que suportem a tomada de decisão e a excelência operacional.

O papel exige forte interação com áreas técnicas, operações de TI, times de dados/BI e stakeholders de negócio, traduzindo demandas operacionais e estratégicas em indicadores mensuráveis, acionáveis e alinhados aos objetivos organizacionais.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Estruturar, evoluir e governar o framework de indicadores de performance de serviços de TI;
  • Garantir padronização metodológica, clareza conceitual e rastreabilidade dos indicadores;
  • Definir conceitos, fórmulas, regras de cálculo e critérios de análise de KPIs;
  • Identificar e priorizar lacunas de mensuração nos pilares de custo, prazo, qualidade e nível de serviço (SLAs/SLOs);
  • Conduzir ciclos de validação de indicadores junto às áreas técnicas e stakeholders;
  • Atuar na gestão e priorização do backlog de indicadores, considerando impacto e viabilidade;
  • Apoiar a construção e evolução de frameworks de governança de performance em TI;
  • Monitorar a maturidade dos indicadores e propor melhorias contínuas;
  • Atuar em conjunto com times de BI e dados para implementação e operacionalização das métricas;
  • Traduzir demandas estratégicas e operacionais em indicadores acionáveis;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, apoiando lideranças na tomada de decisão orientada por dados.


Requisitos e qualificações:

Obrigatórios

  • Formação superior ou pós-graduação em Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Vivência na definição, estruturação e governança de KPIs e indicadores de performance;
  • Experiência em ambientes de TI, com interface entre áreas técnicas, operações e dados;
  • Capacidade de atuação tanto em nível estratégico quanto no detalhamento conceitual de indicadores;
  • Experiência com stakeholders e suporte à tomada de decisão baseada em dados.


Desejáveis

  • Experiência em ambientes de Centro de Serviços Compartilhados (CSC) ou operações de serviços de TI;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, etc.);
  • Experiência em Data & Analytics;
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de gestão de serviços (ITIL) e governança (COBIT);
  • Vivência com metodologias de melhoria contínua (Lean, Six Sigma);
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos complexos ou de grande porte.


Diferenciais do perfil

  • Experiência prévia na estruturação de indicadores corporativos de TI;
  • Atuação em governança de métricas de performance e eficiência operacional;
  • Capacidade de conectar dados técnicos com impacto de negócio;
  • Perfil analítico, estruturado e orientado à melhoria contínua.



Sobre a empresa

Become a Compasser, be part of AI/R.

Compass UOL is a global firm and part of the AI Revolution Company, together transforming organizations using Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and other of today’s most advanced techno

logies.We equip our team with proprietary and external AI-driven tools to design and build digital-native platforms, integrating cutting-edge technologies and enabling companies to innovate, transform their businesses, and drive success in their m

arkets.To achieve this, we attract and develop the best talent, creating opportunities that enhance people’s lives and highlight the positive impact of disruptive techno

logies.We empower borderless talent and promote knowledge and opportunities in the latest market trends, driving significant personal and professional


growth.

title: Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst para atuar na estruturação, evolução e governança do framework de indicadores de performance de serviços de Tecnologia da Informação, em ambiente corporativo de grande porte.

Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a consistência, padronização e confiabilidade dos indicadores utilizados na gestão de performance de serviços de TI, atuando de forma estratégica na definição e evolução de métricas que suportem a tomada de decisão e a excelência operacional.

O papel exige forte interação com áreas técnicas, operações de TI, times de dados/BI e stakeholders de negócio, traduzindo demandas operacionais e estratégicas em indicadores mensuráveis, acionáveis e alinhados aos objetivos organizacionais.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Estruturar, evoluir e governar o framework de indicadores de performance de serviços de TI;
  • Garantir padronização metodológica, clareza conceitual e rastreabilidade dos indicadores;
  • Definir conceitos, fórmulas, regras de cálculo e critérios de análise de KPIs;
  • Identificar e priorizar lacunas de mensuração nos pilares de custo, prazo, qualidade e nível de serviço (SLAs/SLOs);
  • Conduzir ciclos de validação de indicadores junto às áreas técnicas e stakeholders;
  • Atuar na gestão e priorização do backlog de indicadores, considerando impacto e viabilidade;
  • Apoiar a construção e evolução de frameworks de governança de performance em TI;
  • Monitorar a maturidade dos indicadores e propor melhorias contínuas;
  • Atuar em conjunto com times de BI e dados para implementação e operacionalização das métricas;
  • Traduzir demandas estratégicas e operacionais em indicadores acionáveis;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, apoiando lideranças na tomada de decisão orientada por dados.


Requisitos e qualificações:

Obrigatórios

  • Formação superior ou pós-graduação em Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Vivência na definição, estruturação e governança de KPIs e indicadores de performance;
  • Experiência em ambientes de TI, com interface entre áreas técnicas, operações e dados;
  • Capacidade de atuação tanto em nível estratégico quanto no detalhamento conceitual de indicadores;
  • Experiência com stakeholders e suporte à tomada de decisão baseada em dados.


Desejáveis

  • Experiência em ambientes de Centro de Serviços Compartilhados (CSC) ou operações de serviços de TI;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, etc.);
  • Experiência em Data & Analytics;
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de gestão de serviços (ITIL) e governança (COBIT);
  • Vivência com metodologias de melhoria contínua (Lean, Six Sigma);
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos complexos ou de grande porte.


Diferenciais do perfil

  • Experiência prévia na estruturação de indicadores corporativos de TI;
  • Atuação em governança de métricas de performance e eficiência operacional;
  • Capacidade de conectar dados técnicos com impacto de negócio;
  • Perfil analítico, estruturado e orientado à melhoria contínua.



Sobre a empresa

Become a Compasser, be part of AI/R.

Compass UOL is a global firm and part of the AI Revolution Company, together transforming organizations using Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and other of today’s most advanced techno

logies.We equip our team with proprietary and external AI-driven tools to design and build digital-native platforms, integrating cutting-edge technologies and enabling companies to innovate, transform their businesses, and drive success in their m

arkets.To achieve this, we attract and develop the best talent, creating opportunities that enhance people’s lives and highlight the positive impact of disruptive techno

logies.We empower borderless talent and promote knowledge and opportunities in the latest market trends, driving significant personal and professional


growth.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para ML/AI Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ML/AI Engineer (Databricks)


Location: Remote (Brazil) | Type: Contract | Experience: 3 to 5+ years

About the Role


We're hiring an ML/AI Engineer to build and ship machine learning and AI systems on top of a modern Databricks data platform. You'll work close to the data, turning messy enterprise sources into features, models, and AI-powered applications that run reliably in production rather than living in a notebook.


The client is a data and AI platform company that modernizes how energy and heavy-industry enterprises work with their data, migrating legacy systems onto Databricks and the lakehouse and then building intelligence on top of it. The work is hands-on and full-lifecycle: you'll touch pipelines, models, and the services that put predictions in front of real users.


This role suits someone who likes living at the seam between data engineering and ML. If you've shipped models that depend on real pipelines holding up, and you want to do that work on a clean Databricks stack instead of fighting infrastructure, you'll feel at home here.

  • Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights;
  • Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making;

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders;
  • Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes;

TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA);

ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;

title: ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.


EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.


Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.


Tasks and responsibilities:

  • Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency;
  • Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders;
  • Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications;
  • Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps;
  • Maintain a centralized log or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization;
  • Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots;
  • Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials;
  • Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;


Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline;
  • +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology;
  • +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams;
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting;
  • Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize);
  • Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights;
  • Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making;
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates;
  • Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred;
  • Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail;
  • AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders;
  • Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes;
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices;
  • Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including:

TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA);

ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;

  • Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus;
  • Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage;
  • Fluent in English;

  • Production MDM experience for at least one major platform.

  • Comfort with configuration management or infrastructure as code is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, firewalls) and a SaaS or GRC management platform.

About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. The SAP BW Lead will be responsible for leading end to end SAP BW initiatives, including architecture, design, development, migration, and operational support across SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA landscapes. The role will also own real time and near real time data replication using SAP SLT, ensure performant analytics leveraging Native HANA modeling, and act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams.

This is a hands on leadership role requiring deep technical expertise as well as team and delivery ownership.


Key Responsibilities:


Advanced English


• Lead design and implementation of SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA solutions including modeling, data acquisition, transformations, and reporting layers.


• Define and govern BW architecture standards, object reuse strategy, naming conventions, transport strategy, and performance benchmarks.


• Own delivery across implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support engagements.

Data Acquisition & Integration (SLT Focus)


• Design and manage real time and delta data replication from SAP ECC / SAP S/4HANA to BW using SAP SLT.


• Ensure optimal data flow design covering ODP, SLT, and standard extractors, with reconciliation and monitoring frameworks.


• Work closely with Basis and source system teams to ensure stable and scalable replication setups.


SAP BW Modeling & Transformations:


o InfoObjects, ADSOs (Field based & InfoObject based)


o Composite Providers, Open ODS Views


o Transformations, DTPs, Process Chains


Design and optimize Native HANA objects, including:


o Calculation Views, Table Functions, SQL Script procedures

o CDS Views (where applicable)

• Leverage push down logic to HANA to improve query and load performance.


• Collaborate with BW and HANA teams to decide optimal BW vs Native HANA modeling strategy.


Reporting & Analytics:


Oversee reporting solutions using:


o BEx Queries / Analysis for Office / SAP BO / SAC (where applicable)


• Ensure reporting performance, semantic consistency, and business KPI alignment across domains (FI, CO, SD, MM, Supply Chain).


Migration & Modernization:


Lead BW on HANA / BW/4HANA conversion and migration programs, including:


o Readiness checks and simplification item handling


o Remediation of custom code and data models


o Data volume management and performance validation


• Support S/4HANA transformation programs from an analytics perspective.

Production Support & Governance

• Act as escalation point for production issues, SLA adherence, root cause analysis, and resolution.

• Ensure strong governance around transports (ChaRM), releases, incident/change management, and documentation.


Team & Stakeholder Leadership:


• Mentor and guide SAP BW developers and HANA modelers.

• Work closely with business stakeholders, functional teams, architects, and program managers.

• Contribute to effort estimation, planning, and delivery commitments.

title: English Teacher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English Teacher em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Overview


Most English schools in Brazil sell the same thing: promises. Promises of fluency. Promises of confidence. Promises of transformation. And most of them fail to deliver. Not because their teachers aren't capable, but because their model was never built around results in the first place.


AM Consultoria de Inglês was built differently.


We work exclusively with adult learners, using a communicative approach that prioritises real speaking ability. We measure what actually matters: whether our students can use English to do something meaningful with their lives. Every class, every follow-up, every piece of feedback we give is designed with that outcome in mind.


We're growing. And we're looking for a teacher who wants to be part of something that takes results seriously.


If you want a place to clock in, teach, and clock out, this isn't it. If you want to build something that genuinely changes people's lives, read on.



Position Details


  • Role: English Language Coach
  • Location: 100% Remote
  • Employment Type: Contract
  • Start Date: Immediate


Candidates MUST be available Monday through Thursday, 7–9pm. Weekly team meeting: Mondays at 10am (30 minutes).



What You'll Do


  • Plan and deliver engaging, communicative classes that students actually remember
  • Support students via WhatsApp between sessions. We stay close to our learners
  • Proactively check in with students to understand their needs and keep them on track
  • Pursue your own professional development. We expect it and we support it



Technical Requirements


  • High-quality video and audio setup
  • Fast, stable internet connection



What We Require


  • CELTA, DELTA, or TKT certification (Cambridge)
  • C2 English proficiency
  • Strong command of Communicative Language Teaching methodology
  • Confident use of online teaching platforms and digital tools



What We're Looking For


Beyond qualifications, we're looking for someone who:


  • Brings genuine energy to every class, Not performance, real presence
  • Is ambitious and wants to grow, with potential to take on leadership responsibility
  • Receives feedback well and actively uses it to improve
  • Communicates proactively and takes ownership of their students' progress
  • Is humble enough to keep learning, no matter their level of experience
  • Has lived, worked, or studied in an English-speaking environment (a strong advantage)



Why AM Consultoria


  • Above-average compensation compared to the broader ESL market in Brazil
  • A methodology that actually works, and that you'll be proud to deliver
  • Adult learners who are motivated, goal-driven, and serious about progress
  • Real input into how we develop and improve our product
  • A small, high-performance team that holds each other to a high standard
  • Room to grow into more than a teacher



We'll be sharing more about our vision, mission, and approach via the link below. If what you've read here resonates — we'd like to hear from you.


Apply now.

description:

  • Definir padrões de segurança, governança e qualidade para uso de IA sobre dados sensíveis (incluindo dados de menores), garantindo conformidade com LGPD e regulações equivalentes em contexto multi-país.
  • Atuar como referência técnica do time de dados (Revisões de arquitetura; Code review; Mentoria e definição de padrões)
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas.
  • Orientar decisões de arquitetura em AWS.
  • Apoiar planejamento técnico, estimativas e evolução do roadmap da plataforma.

title: Head of Compliance, Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Compliance, Brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Head of Compliance & MLRO to oversee the company's compliance and regulatory responsibilities in Brazil. This role will support the business in maintaining a strong compliance culture, managing regulatory relationships, and ensuring alignment with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.


Working closely with local and regional stakeholders, the successful candidate will provide practical compliance guidance while supporting the company's growth and licensing initiatives in Brazil.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the designated MLRO and lead compliance representative for the Brazil business.
  • Oversee the company's compliance, AML/CFT, sanctions, and financial crime programs.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and provide guidance on relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain relationships with regulators and support regulatory enquiries, reviews, and examinations.
  • Support licensing, registration, and other regulatory initiatives as required.
  • Provide compliance advice to business and operational teams on new products, services, and business activities.
  • Help ensure policies, procedures, and controls remain effective and aligned with regulatory expectations.
  • Oversee key compliance processes, including customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Identify compliance risks and work with stakeholders to implement appropriate controls and solutions.
  • Prepare compliance updates and reporting for management.
  • Deliver compliance training and promote a strong culture of compliance across the organization.
  • Collaborate with regional and global teams on compliance-related matters.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Experience in Compliance, AML/Financial Crime, Regulatory Affairs, or a related function within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or digital assets.
  • Prior experience as an MLRO, Compliance Officer, or similar compliance role is preferred.
  • Good understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements and AML/CFT obligations.
  • Experience interacting with regulators, auditors, or other external stakeholders is advantageous.
  • Exposure to licensing, regulatory approvals, or compliance projects is beneficial.
  • Experience within digital assets, fintech, payments, or financial institutions is preferred.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a dynamic and evolving environment.
  • Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, CFE, or equivalent are a plus.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.


Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.


OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Consultor SAP Data Migration - Viagens Mensais
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor SAP Data Migration - Viagens Mensais em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

O que procuramos?

Buscamos um profissional de SAP Data Migration com perfil analítico, resiliente e proativo para atuar em um dos projetos mais estratégicos do nosso portfólio: o rollout global de migração do SAP ECC para o S/4HANA. O perfil ideal deve estar confortável em transitar por ambientes de alta complexidade técnica e funcional. O maior desafio será atuar como facilitador na transição de uma cultura de sistema altamente customizado (ECC) para a aderência ao template global (S/4HANA), garantindo a integridade dos dados enquanto lida com as particularidades da localização Brasil e os impactos da reforma tributária. Se você possui facilidade de comunicação em inglês e expertise em grandes volumes de dados, essa vaga é para você.

Atribuições principais:

Sólida experiência em projetos de migração de dados SAP (Data Migration). · Conhecimento técnico em ferramentas de migração como SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit (LTMC/LTMOM), LSMW ou SAP BODS. · Vivência prévia em projetos de Rollout e/ou conversão para S/4HANA. · Entendimento das estruturas de dados e tabelas do SAP ECC e S/4HANA. · Experiência com Localização Brasil (impostos, notas fiscais, requisitos legais). · Capacidade de lidar com ambientes complexos, múltiplos landscapes e sistemas altamente customizados.

Requisitos:

Executar o ciclo completo de migração de dados (extração, transformação, carga e validação) do SAP ECC para o S/4HANA. · Realizar o mapeamento de campos (Field Mapping) entre o sistema legado customizado e o novo template global. · Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os donos de processos (BPOs) para garantir que as regras de negócio sejam refletidas na migração. · Garantir o saneamento e a qualidade dos dados (Data Cleansing) antes da carga no ambiente produtivo. · Apoiar a adaptação da localização Brasil dentro do contexto global, considerando as exigências fiscais atuais e futuras (Reforma Tributária). · Participar de reuniões diárias e workshops com times globais utilizando o idioma inglês.

Diferenciais:

Conhecimento profundo em SAP Data Services (BODS). · Certificação SAP S/4HANA. · Entendimento preliminar dos impactos da Reforma Tributária brasileira no ambiente SAP. · Experiência anterior em projetos com metodologia SAP Activate. · Habilidade em lidar com gestão de mudanças (Change Management) técnica junto ao cliente.

Localidade da posição: Belo Horizonte - MG

Formato de atuação: Remoto com viagens para MG

Idioma: Inglês - Nível: Avançado

Porque construir sua carreira na Meta?

Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade de interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo o Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas que mais crescem no país há 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informática Hoje.

Quais são nossos valores?

- Somos pessoas servindo pessoas

- Pensamos e agimos como donos

- Temos gana por performance

- Crescemos e aprendemos juntos

- Buscamos excelência e a simplicidade

- Temos inovação e criatividade no nosso DNA

Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas independentemente de sua condição, deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, aparência, idade ou afins. Queremos que você cresça conosco em um ambiente acolhedor e repleto de oportunidades.

Se identificou? Então, #VemSerMeta!

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Declaration Drafter - Immigration em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who Are We?


Bueno Law is a trailblazing immigration law firm focused on empowering the Latin American LGBTQ+ community, survivors of domestic violence, victims of human trafficking, and other vulnerable individuals. We provide life-changing legal services to immigrants in the United States, and we’re looking for passionate, people-first individuals to join our remote team.


We specialize in:


  • Removal Defense (EOIR).
  • Asylum & Humanitarian Relief (U/T visas, VAWA, SIJS).
  • Family‑Based Immigration.

Your Role as a Declaration Drafter


We are looking for an immigration declaration drafter to join our team of Warriors. We do not require experience; we offer a full training program. The ideal candidate is 100% fluent in English and Portuguese, has excellent writing and communication skills, is detail-oriented and a self-starter. Experience in the Psychological or Social Services field. Must be able to work well with different cultures and languages. We require a positive attitude and someone who strives for finding solutions instead of obstacles. We would like the new Warrior to be able to commit full-time to this position (9am-6pm PST).


Who we are looking for:


  • Experience in providing psychological or social services
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Portuguese
  • Ability to Multi-Task
  • Strong Analytical Skills
  • Decision-Making ability
  • Strong Research Skills
  • Team Player
  • Excellent Customer Service Skills
  • Highly organized individual
  • Fast learner
  • Honest
  • Excellent time management skills
  • Must match our growth and improvement mindset and help implement efficiency techniques
  • Reliable and dependable
  • Hardworking 


Essential Duties And Responsibilities:


  • Schedule appointments and maintain calendars.
  • Write and edit documents from letters to reports and instructional documents.
  • Create and maintain filing systems, both electronic and physical.
  • Handle daily client communications.
  • Maintains filing systems as assigned.
  • Retrieves information as requested from records, email, minutes, and other related documents; prepares written summaries of data when needed.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.


What We Offer:


  • Competitive pay above market rate.
  • Paid vacation + sick leave.
  • Your birthday off.
  • U.S. paid holidays.
  • Mon–Fri, 9 AM–6 PM PST.
  • A mission‑driven, inclusive, supportive team.


How to Apply:


Send your resume to with the position in the subject line.

Applications submitted through LinkedIn will not be reviewed.
