title: Global Talent & Leadership Development Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Global Talent & Leadership Development Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us


Pyxus / Alliance One International, headquartered in Morrisville, North Carolina, USA is a leading global supplier of tobacco leaf. With operations in approximately 30 countries, we deliver high-quality, value-added products and services to customers in over 90 countries. As a trusted partner in the industry, we prioritize responsible sourcing, sustainability, and traceability. Our commitment to ethical practices and environmental stewardship is a cornerstone of our operations worldwide.


Key Responsibilities

  • Talent Reviews & Succession Planning

Collaborates in the design and implementation of the global Talent Management framework to ensure a strong and consistent leadership pipeline across the organization. Aligns Oracle systems with business needs and drives global adoption of talent practices. Facilitates annual Talent Reviews and calibration sessions, partners with Regional HR to identify critical roles, and develops succession plans for M4+ leadership positions. Monitors development progress and provides talent insights and metrics to support workforce planning and strategic decisions.

  • Learning & Development

Leads the global Learning & Development strategy aligned with business priorities and capability needs. Works closely with HR and business leaders to define learning priorities and deliver leadership, management, and professional development programs. Oversees LinkedIn Learning and Oracle Learning platforms, including governance, campaigns, user experience, and vendor management. Tracks participation, engagement, and career outcomes, using data, KPIs, and ROI analysis to continuously improve learning effectiveness.

  • Pyxus Academy Rotational Program

Leads the design, governance, and execution of the rotational program, partnering with business leaders and HR to identify opportunities and participants. Coordinates selection, development plans, and stakeholder alignment, while monitoring progress and outcomes to strengthen the internal talent pipeline through hands-on and cross-functional experiences.

  • Reporting & KPIs

Develops and tracks metrics to measure the efficiency and impact of talent and learning initiatives, using data-driven insights to improve processes.

  • Budget & Resource Management

Monitors budget adherence and manages contracts with external vendors to ensure effective and strategic use of resources.


Qualifications/Requirements:

  • Fluent English
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, HR or related field required
  • Relevant business operations and Human Resources experience
  • Experience in deploying Talent Reviews & Succession Planning, Learning and Development programs and rotational development initiatives
  • Strong change agility and proven ability to deal with ambiguity
  • Leadership experience or comparable leadership responsibility
  • Influencing diverse teams in a global organization without formal leadership
  • Strategic orientation and critical thinking skills with the ability to align and integrate HR programs toward a holistic global approach to localization and business applicability
  • Demonstrated success in driving and successfully completing HR projects and process improvements in a global workplace
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and collaborative skills across levels, with an ability to persuade and influence, and the ability to build enthusiasm and commitment
  • Highly flexible, agile, collaborative, and effective at leading and delivering business imperatives in a dynamic environment
  • Business acumen paired with a hands-on mentality and the ability to match business needs with HR deliverables
  • Analytical and data-driven, with the ability to integrate complex data into insights to create future-focused, high-impact people business strategies
  • Work experience in multiple HR roles and organizations (COE, HRBP, SS)
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressured, ambiguous work environment, paying close attention to detail and meeting business-driven deadlines
  • Demonstrated organizational skills and ability to coordinate multiple activities and shift priorities meeting established deadlines
  • Demonstrated ability to break down problems into manageable tasks and processes while challenging assumptions
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with extreme professionalism and discretion


Benefits

Profit-Sharing Program (PPR)

Health Insurance Plans

50% Medication Allowance

Education and foreign language allowance

Mobile Phone Plan

Private Pension Plan

Meal Card

Corporate Time Off Days

Wellhub

Group Life Insurance


Applications are open until Jun 28, 2026.


All opportunities offered by Alliance One consider candidates’ alignment with our STAR values (Supportive, Transparent, Adaptable, and Responsible), in addition to fostering an inclusive culture committed to social responsibility and equity. This includes Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Race, Ethnicity, and Religion.

title: AI / ML Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI / ML Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a remote, full-time AI / ML Engineer with 4+ years of machine learning experience, preferably within MarTech SaaS companies, to join the engineering team of our U.S. client. You will join our client's innovative, growing team on a mission to unleash the power of culture for growing organizational brands at a time of global, seismic cultural transformation.

You will work with the AI / ML Manager on the Data Science team, developing agentic AI workflows with customized hybrid retrieval and contextual pipelines. The right candidate will have the opportunity to develop a wide range of machine learning and AI techniques to create features for the client's UI / UX and internal tools. You will work collaboratively with, and be a key member of, the research and development team, collaborating closely with software engineers, research teams, and product design, creating novel methods for automating the generation of these data-driven insights from PoC all the way to deployment at scale within the client platform.

If you are a self-starter who enjoys a fast-paced, dynamic, and autonomous environment as well as thrive in challenging situations, then you are the right person for the job. The ideal candidate must collaborate well within a team, leverage strong Generative AI and Machine Learning expertise, and adeptly apply and adapt existing code, innovating new approaches needed to deliver on insights.

Our client unleashes the power of culture, driving brand growth with consumer insights, analytics, tools, and best practices for over 250 major U.S. brands. Its solutions are fueled by its cultural intelligence platform, which allows its customers to more effectively and efficiently understand, reach, and engage consumers, activating them across race, ethnicity, generation, gender, and sexual identity.

Our client comprises creative, analytical, diverse, hardworking, and fun individuals with an insatiable curiosity for the new collage of behaviors and patterns driving consumers today. The possibilities of the moment and opportunity to help organizations unlock their cultural capacity inspire them to seek out predictive insights and brand impacts that are unique to their model.


Responsibilities

  • Develop a wide range of data science techniques, including supervised and unsupervised learning, dimensionality reduction, network analyses, natural language processing, statistical analyses, classification, and similarity modelling.
  • Partner with product and engineering teams to execute in an Agile development environment.
  • Research market trends and innovations in data technologies and analytical approaches to drive innovation while facilitating data platform scalability
  • Develop features with LLMs, VLMs, and ViTs that enable analysis, summarization, and production-ready output of content using the client's internal research data.
  • Develop and maintain strong retrieval augmented generation pipelines with customized time sensitivity, hybrid search methods, and weighting.
  • Develop REST API Endpoints to allow the application's backend to service from the client's AI workflows, maintaining and monitoring token expenditure, latency, and related metrics.
  • Experience with prompt engineering for complex and multi-agent pipelines efficiently, ensuring regression compatibility and with guardrails for hallucination.
  • Develop and design integrations and MCPs with both unstructured and structured data into efficient tools used by AI Agents.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 4+ years of professional experience as a data scientist, preferably in the marketing area
  • 4+ years of relevant work experience in a machine learning or data science role; experience specifically in consumer advertising and marketing or social media is a plus
  • Strong Python skills and/or other platforms and languages (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, SQL, R) and Python libraries
  • Business experience solving analytical issues through quantitative approaches and machine learning methods, as well as experience using advanced statistical methods, data mining techniques, and information retrieval
  • Experience in applying data science methodologies to solve problems, particularly in the marketing domain
  • Experience working with AI and machine learning for product development with LiteLLM, CrewAI, Langchain, Langraph, and similar wrappers.
  • Experience working with AI observability, tracing, spans, and tools tracking (DataDog Observability, Langfuse, Langchain, Arize, or others)
  • Knowledge of probability and statistics (e.g., distributions, hypothesis testing, time series concepts, Bayesian framework)
  • Truly a team player: likes to work with others to get a clear understanding of the context around the data; can happily interact with extraverted thinkers; and can adapt to new information
  • High comfort in analyzing and manipulating large, complex, high-dimensional data from numerous sources
  • Experience working in a cloud environment (AWS preferred)
  • Curiosity and passion for learning
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Advanced university degree (master's degree or equivalent degree) in computer science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, physics, econometrics, or equivalent quantitative fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: System Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para System Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sr. Workday Application Engineer – Workday Integrations (Corporate Services)

Overview

Join a leading retail organization as a Senior Application Engineer focused on Workday integrations . In this role, you will own the integration layer that connects Workday to enterprise systems across payroll, compliance, legal, facilities, asset protection, and analytics.

You’ll partner closely with Product, Architecture, and business teams to build scalable, reliable integrations that improve operational efficiency and employee experience.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and support end-to-end Workday integrations across enterprise systems
  • Partner with Product and Architecture teams to align on integration strategy, standards, and roadmap
  • Own data flow and connectivity for employee (P&C) data across internal systems and third-party vendors


Must-Have Qualifications

  • 7+ years of enterprise integration experience in complex environments
  • Strong hands-on experience with Workday Extend
  • Deep experience with Workday integration tools:
  • Workday Studio
  • Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB)
  • Core Connectors
  • Experience building custom integrations for high-volume or complex scenarios
  • Strong debugging skills (break/fix, data flow troubleshooting)


Nice-to-Have

  • Experience building self-healing integrations or proactive alerting systems
  • Experience supporting global enterprise HR systems
  • Exposure to downstream systems (payroll, compliance, vendors, etc.)
  • Experience with Workday calculated fields and advanced data modeling


Compensation : $25-32/hour

Duration : 6+ months

Sobre a oportunidade


Estamos em busca de um(a) Head Comercial para liderar a expansão da nossa frente de Dados, atuando na geração de novos negócios, desenvolvimento de mercado e crescimento de receita. Buscamos um perfil fortemente hunter, com experiência na venda consultiva de serviços e soluções de Dados, capaz de construir relacionamentos estratégicos com executivos de grandes empresas e identificar oportunidades que gerem impacto real nos negócios dos clientes.

Essa pessoa terá papel fundamental na consolidação e crescimento da vertical de Dados da UDS, atuando na comercialização de serviços, projetos e soluções relacionadas a Analytics, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Inteligência Artificial e Data Platforms.


Principais responsabilidades


• Desenvolver e executar estratégias comerciais para expansão da vertical de Dados da UDS;

• Prospectar e conquistar novos clientes, ampliando a receita e a presença da empresa no mercado;

• Identificar oportunidades de projetos e soluções em Dados, Analytics, BI, Engenharia de Dados e Inteligência Artificial;

• Conduzir negociações consultivas de médio e grande porte junto a executivos e tomadores de decisão;

• Construir relacionamento com C-Levels, Diretores, Heads e gestores das áreas de Tecnologia, Dados, Inovação, Operações e Negócios;

• Gerenciar todo o ciclo comercial, desde a prospecção até o fechamento dos contratos;

• Atuar em parceria com os times técnicos e de pré-vendas na construção de propostas de valor aderentes às necessidades dos clientes;

• Monitorar indicadores, pipeline, forecast e metas comerciais;

• Contribuir para o posicionamento da UDS como referência em soluções de Dados e IA no mercado.


Requisitos


• Experiência comprovada em vendas consultivas B2B com foco em Dados, Analytics, Business Intelligence, Engenharia de Dados ou Inteligência Artificial;

• Perfil Hunter, com forte capacidade de geração de demanda e abertura de mercado;

• Histórico consistente de fechamento de contratos de serviços e projetos de tecnologia;

• Experiência na negociação com empresas de médio e grande porte;

• Conhecimento do mercado de Dados e suas principais tendências, desafios e oportunidades;

• Vivência em consultorias de Dados ou consultorias de Tecnologia que possuam áreas relevantes de Dados e Analytics;

• Forte orientação para resultados, metas, indicadores e crescimento de receita;

• Excelente comunicação, negociação e relacionamento executivo.


Desejáveis


• Experiência comercializando soluções de IA Generativa;

• Vivência em empresas de consultoria de dados, analytics ou transformação digital;

• Carteira de relacionamento com executivos das áreas de Tecnologia, Dados, Inovação e Transformação Digital;

• Conhecimento em plataformas cloud (AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud) aplicadas a projetos de Dados;

• Experiência na estruturação ou expansão de unidades de negócio focadas em Dados.

title: PRODUCT DESIGNER SÊNIOR | REMOTO
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para PRODUCT DESIGNER SÊNIOR | REMOTO em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

LOCALIZA&CO

Estar em constante evolução nos trouxe até aqui. Ao lado de talentos e habilidades múltiplas nos conectamos em busca da nossa motivação: construir o futuro da mobilidade sustentável. É por meio da valorização da individualidade de cada um que impulsionamos o nosso movimento para conquistar resultados extraordinários, desenvolver nossas operações e criar soluções para os nossos clientes.

Somos apaixonados por nossa história, por nossas ideias e pela capacidade de realizá-las. Sabemos que juntos, todos vamos mais longe.

É assim que conectamos a Localiza&Co com o futuro.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como Product Designer Sênior, você terá um papel estratégico na construção de soluções complexas, atuando de forma transversal entre múltiplos produtos, squads e áreas de negócio.


Esperamos uma atuação que vá além da execução, com forte orientação estratégica, capacidade de influência e visão sistêmica. Você deve ser capaz de conectar decisões de design aos objetivos de negócio, antecipar problemas e oportunidades com base em contexto e dados, e atuar de forma proativa na definição de direcionamentos para produtos e jornadas complexas.


Você será responsável por:

  • Mapear e evoluir jornadas complexas, conectando diferentes produtos, jornadas e stakeholders, garantindo consistência e visão integrada da experiência;
  • Construir e manter relações de confiança com áreas parceiras e stakeholders (produto, tecnologia, negócio, marketing, operações), construindo alinhamento e direcionamento claro mesmo em cenários ambíguos;
  • Antecipar riscos e problemas de experiência, atuando de forma proativa para mitigá-los antes de impactarem o usuário ou o negócio;
  • Apoiar decisões estratégicas de produto, utilizando dados, experimentação e visão de negócio;
  • Promover a cultura de Design e pensamento centrado no usuário, elevando o nível de maturidade da organização;
  • Conduzir e orientar pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas, traduzindo dados em insights acionáveis;
  • Desenvolver soluções, jornadas e interfaces, garantindo excelência em usabilidade, consistência e impacto;
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento do time, compartilhando conhecimento, repertório e boas práticas.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Domínio de pesquisa com usuários (quali e quanti) e validação de hipóteses;
  • Excelência em UI e UX, equilibrando estética, usabilidade e consistência;
  • Domínio de Figma e ferramentas de prototipação em IA;
  • Excelente comunicação e articulação, com capacidade de simplificar temas complexos e influenciar decisões;
  • Forte habilidade de relacionamento, construindo parcerias sólidas e colaborativas com diferentes stakeholders;
  • Visão holística e sistêmica, entendendo o impacto das decisões de design no ecossistema como um todo;
  • Experiência em projetos complexos, envolvendo múltiplas squads, produtos e áreas;
  • Capacidade de navegar em ambientes ambíguos, trazendo clareza, direcionamento e foco;
  • Proatividade e senso de urgência, antecipando problemas e agindo no tempo certo;
  • Experiência em mapeamento de jornadas complexas e identificação de oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Habilidade em facilitar dinâmicas colaborativas, como co-criação, workshops e alinhamentos estratégicos;
  • Capacidade de mediação e gestão de conflitos, equilibrando diferentes interesses com foco no melhor resultado;
  • Pensamento orientado a dados e resultados, conectando design a métricas de negócio.


BENEFÍCIOS DESSA POSIÇÃO

  • Participação nos Lucros
  • Carro Corporativo
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Vale Refeição
  • Convênio Médico
  • Convênio Odontológico
  • Gympass
  • Previdência Privada
  • Auxílio Home Office
  • Allya
  • Acesso ilimitado a diversos cursos da nossa Universidade Localiza
  • Programas internos de treinamento e desenvolvimento

title: Analista SAP Master Data Pleno (MM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista SAP Master Data Pleno (MM) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Você atuará em nosso cliente, uma empresa consolidada, com forte atuação na área de controladoria e processos financeiros, oferecendo um ambiente estruturado, colaborativo e com foco em qualidade de dados e governança.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Criação e atualização de materiais no SAP (módulo MM)
  • Cadastro e manutenção de fornecedores e clientes
  • Gestão e atualização de dados mestres (Master Data)
  • Suporte na revisão e padronização de cadastros legados
  • Garantia de conformidade com políticas internas e regras contábeis/fiscais
  • Atualização de retenção de impostos (J1BTAX)
  • Atuação junto às áreas de contabilidade e controladoria


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência com SAP, principalmente no módulo MM
  • Vivência com gestão de dados mestres (Master Data)
  • Experiência em cadastros (materiais, fornecedores e clientes)
  • Conhecimento em processos fiscais e/ou contábeis


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Inglês ou espanhol intermediário
  • Organização e atenção a detalhes
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração com áreas de negócio
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com dados e padronizações


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. Regime Híbrido

São Paulo (SP): 2x3

Curitiba (PR): 4x1

Importante: embora a vaga esteja publicada como remota na plataforma, é necessário residir próximo a uma dessas localidades ou ter disponibilidade para mudança.


Regime de Contratação

CLT


Benefícios para você

* Vale Refeição

* Vale Alimentação

* Assistência Médica

* Assistência Odontológica

* Seguro de Vida

* Gym Pass

* Auxílio Pet


Além disso, oferecemos :

* Incentivo a estudo após completar 1 ano de Dexian

* Programa de desenvolvimento e treinamentos

* Formação através da Trilha de Liderança

title: (Freelancer PJ) Engenheiro de Dados / Desenvolvedor BI
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para (Freelancer PJ) Engenheiro de Dados / Desenvolvedor BI em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A NowVertical está em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados / Desenvolvedor(a) BI Freelancer para atuar no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de soluções de Data Warehouse (DW), apoiando projetos estratégicos de dados e analytics.


Se você possui perfil analítico, experiência sólida em engenharia de dados e interesse em atuar em demandas desafiadoras em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, essa pode ser uma excelente oportunidade para contribuir com projetos de alto impacto em uma empresa global em expansão.


Principais atividades:

  • Desenvolver e manter incrementos e evoluções em ambientes de Data Warehouse (DW);
  • Implementar e aprimorar pipelines de dados, garantindo qualidade, performance e confiabilidade das informações;
  • Desenvolver regras de negócio e integrações utilizando Python;
  • Criar, otimizar e manter consultas SQL para processamento e análise de dados;
  • Trabalhar com orquestração de fluxos de dados utilizando Apache Airflow;
  • Atuar na modelagem, transformação e disponibilização de dados para consumo analítico;
  • Colaborar com equipes técnicas e de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e definição de soluções;
  • Participar da identificação e resolução de problemas relacionados à engenharia de dados e performance dos ambientes;
  • Apoiar a documentação técnica e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência com Apache Airflow para orquestração de fluxos e pipelines de dados;
  • Desenvolvimento em Python para implementação de regras de negócio e integrações;
  • Conhecimento em ClickHouse;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em SQL;
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma e organizada em demandas simultâneas;
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para trabalhar em equipe.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Git (GitHub, GitLab ou similares);
  • Conhecimento e utilização de Jupyter Notebooks;
  • Vivência em projetos de Business Intelligence, Analytics ou Data Engineering;
  • Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem.


Modelo de trabalho:

  • Contratação Freelancer (PJ);
  • Atuação por demanda, conforme necessidade dos projetos;
  • Modelo remoto/híbrido a combinar.


O que a NowVertical oferece:

  • Participação em projetos estratégicos e desafiadores;
  • Ambiente colaborativo e com alto nível técnico;
  • Flexibilidade e autonomia na execução das atividades;
  • Oportunidade de atuar com tecnologias modernas de dados e analytics.

title: Senior Procurement Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Procurement Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Position Overview

This is not a traditional purchasing role.

We are looking for a procurement leader capable of building strategic relationships with manufacturers, distributors, fabricators, and suppliers across the building envelope industry.

The ideal candidate understands construction procurement, supply chain management, sourcing strategies, and supplier negotiations within industries such as:

  • Architectural Glass & Glazing
  • Curtain Wall Systems
  • Metal Fabrication
  • ACM & Metal Panel Systems
  • Building Envelope Products
  • Insulation Systems
  • Waterproofing & Air Barrier Systems
  • Fasteners & Specialty Construction Products

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop and execute Longarone's procurement strategy.
  • Negotiate national and international supplier agreements.
  • Establish long-term strategic partnerships with manufacturers and distributors.
  • Lead sourcing initiatives focused on cost reduction and supply chain optimization.
  • Collaborate with Estimators and Project Managers during budgeting and project planning.
  • Evaluate new suppliers, products, technologies, and market opportunities.
  • Monitor commodity pricing trends and market fluctuations.
  • Manage procurement forecasting and material planning.
  • Improve procurement systems, reporting, and purchasing controls.
  • Coordinate material purchasing, logistics, and delivery schedules.
  • Present monthly procurement performance reports to executive leadership.



Desired BackgroundRequired
  • 7+ years of procurement, purchasing, sourcing, or supply chain experience.
  • Experience within construction, glazing, architectural glass, façade systems, building envelope, metal fabrication, or related industries.
  • Strong contract negotiation and supplier management experience.
  • Proven track record of generating measurable cost savings.
  • Ability to analyze pricing structures and supplier performance.
  • Fluent English communication skills.


Highly Preferred
  • Existing relationships with manufacturers and distributors in the façade, glazing, curtain wall, or architectural metals sectors.
  • Experience purchasing materials for commercial construction projects.
  • Knowledge of Passive House, high-performance building systems, and modern façade technologies.
  • Experience with ERP and procurement management software.


Success Metrics
  • Procurement Savings
  • Cost Avoidance
  • Supplier Reliability
  • Lead Time Reduction
  • Margin Improvement
  • Forecast Accuracy
  • Supply Chain Stability


Compensation

Competitive Base Salary + Performance Bonus

The selected candidate will participate in a Procurement Savings Incentive Program tied directly to measurable value creation through:

  • Supplier negotiations
  • Strategic sourcing
  • Cost reductions
  • Supply chain improvements
  • Margin enhancement initiatives

Top performers will have significant earning potential tied to their impact on company profitability.



Why Join Longarone?
  • Fully Remote Position
  • Direct Access to Executive Leadership
  • High Growth Environment
  • Opportunity to Build a World-Class Procurement Department
  • Performance-Based Compensation
  • Work on Landmark Building Envelope Projects Throughout the Northeast U.S.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Support Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Theta Data

Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape.


We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously.


The Role

We're hiring a Technical Support Engineer to be the front line of the customer experience at Theta Data. This is not a generic helpdesk role. Our customers are quantitative researchers, developers, and traders who ask technically sophisticated questions about financial data, APIs, and data integrity. You'll need to understand what they're asking and diagnose problems in depth.


Your primary responsibility is to monitor Intercom and Discord to identify, triage, and respond to customer issues as they come in. When you can resolve an issue or provide a working workaround, you do it. When you can't, write a clear, well-documented Jira ticket and escalate to Engineering with everything they need to act quickly, and track the ticket's progress until it's complete. We believe the most important feature is the one the customer already paid for. We take this promise seriously, and we want someone who will, too!


What You'll Do

  • Monitor Intercom and Discord and respond to incoming customer issues in a timely manner
  • Diagnose technical problems related to API behavior, data quality, authentication, request handling, and account set-up
  • Write and run Python scripts to reproduce issues and validate data against expected behavior
  • Make REST API calls to investigate and isolate bugs or unexpected responses
  • Provide workarounds and clear guidance to customers where possible
  • Write thorough, reproducible Jira tickets and escalate unresolved issues
  • Identify recurring issues and surface patterns to help prioritize fixes
  • Create and maintain internal documentation on common issues, workarounds, and resolution steps


What We're Looking For

Required

  • Experience working in a technical support or customer-facing engineering role
  • Comfort working with REST APIs, including reading documentation, making requests, and interpreting responses
  • Working knowledge of Python for scripting, data inspection, and reproducing issues
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both customers and engineers
  • Detail-oriented and systematic approach to diagnosing problems
  • Weekend support rotation


Nice to Have

  • Prior experience with financial data APIs
  • Familiarity with financial data concepts (options, equities, market data, OHLCV, Greeks, etc.)
  • Familiarity with Jira or similar issue tracking tools
  • Experience with Intercom or similar support platforms
  • Exposure to SQL or database queries for data validation


Why Theta Data

  • Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast
  • Real challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data
  • High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter; you will influence how we operate
  • Remote-first: work from anywhere
  • Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily
  • A role that rewards genuine curiosity about financial data and technical problem-solving

title: Senior AI Architect, GenAI & Document Intelligence
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior AI Architect, GenAI & Document Intelligence em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Alyra Technology builds AI-enabled software and automation systems for document-heavy, regulated industries: insurance, legal, finance and healthcare. We pair modern Microsoft Azure architecture with applied generative AI to ship systems that are explainable, auditable and production-ready, not demos. Our work centers on pulling structure, meaning and decisions out of complex, unstructured documents at scale.

Role Description

We're hiring a senior Azure architect who's designed production GenAI systems for messy, real-world documents, and done it for years. Contracts, filings, policies, medical records, financial statements. If you've bolted GPT onto a web app, this isn't your role. If you've built production GenAI pipelines for document-heavy, regulated work, keep reading.

This role is architecture-first. You'll turn ambiguous AI ideas into clear, defensible system designs covering data flows, agent interactions, retrieval pipelines, security boundaries and auditability, primarily on Microsoft Azure. We pull you in as projects launch, so the cadence flexes with the work, lighter in steady stretches and heavier during active builds.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years designing and shipping production AI systems, not just prototyping them
  • 5+ years working directly with unstructured text and document-centric AI. This is non-negotiable.
  • Proven production RAG, multi-agent or document intelligence pipelines at real-world complexity
  • Deep, hands-on Azure platform experience, end to end

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Support Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Theta Data

Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape.


We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously.


The Role

We're hiring a Technical Support Engineer to be the front line of the customer experience at Theta Data. This is not a generic helpdesk role. Our customers are quantitative researchers, developers, and traders who ask technically sophisticated questions about financial data, APIs, and data integrity. You'll need to understand what they're asking and diagnose problems in depth.


Your primary responsibility is to monitor Intercom and Discord to identify, triage, and respond to customer issues as they come in. When you can resolve an issue or provide a working workaround, you do it. When you can't, write a clear, well-documented Jira ticket and escalate to Engineering with everything they need to act quickly, and track the ticket's progress until it's complete. We believe the most important feature is the one the customer already paid for. We take this promise seriously, and we want someone who will, too!


What You'll Do

  • Monitor Intercom and Discord and respond to incoming customer issues in a timely manner
  • Diagnose technical problems related to API behavior, data quality, authentication, request handling, and account set-up
  • Write and run Python scripts to reproduce issues and validate data against expected behavior
  • Make REST API calls to investigate and isolate bugs or unexpected responses
  • Provide workarounds and clear guidance to customers where possible
  • Write thorough, reproducible Jira tickets and escalate unresolved issues
  • Identify recurring issues and surface patterns to help prioritize fixes
  • Create and maintain internal documentation on common issues, workarounds, and resolution steps


What We're Looking For

Required

  • Experience working in a technical support or customer-facing engineering role
  • Comfort working with REST APIs, including reading documentation, making requests, and interpreting responses
  • Working knowledge of Python for scripting, data inspection, and reproducing issues
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both customers and engineers
  • Detail-oriented and systematic approach to diagnosing problems
  • Weekend support rotation


Nice to Have

  • Prior experience with financial data APIs
  • Familiarity with financial data concepts (options, equities, market data, OHLCV, Greeks, etc.)
  • Familiarity with Jira or similar issue tracking tools
  • Experience with Intercom or similar support platforms
  • Exposure to SQL or database queries for data validation


Why Theta Data

  • Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast
  • Real challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data
  • High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter; you will influence how we operate
  • Remote-first: work from anywhere
  • Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily
  • A role that rewards genuine curiosity about financial data and technical problem-solving

title: Spanish and Portuguese speaking customer support
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Spanish and Portuguese speaking customer support em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us


You will be working on customer support for a modern blockchain-based neo-banking app. Exciting opportunity to work with the greatest Blockchain companies.


The Role


As one of our first Customer Support Specialists, you will be the face of our neo-banking app and the primary point of contact for our users.

This is a fully remote position with shift-based scheduling to ensure proper coverage across multiple time zones. You will work in coordination with the other support specialist to provide responsive support during peak user hours.

You’ll handle inbound support, help users resolve issues quickly, and help shape our customer support experience, knowledge base, and processes from the ground up. High performers will have clear growth opportunities into Customer Experience Design, Service Design, and Quality Assurance roles as the team expands.


What You’ll Do


  • Provide high-quality support via tickets, live chat, and email for users
  • Help maintain and improve customer support software
  • Influence the design of our customer experience
  • Help define and refine our customer support processes
  • Guide users through KYC verification, onboarding, payments, account issues, and transaction queries, through guides and ticket support where necessary
  • Strictly follow compliance procedures, particularly around account restrictions, transaction disputes, and regulatory requirements
  • Create, maintain, and continuously improve help center articles in your supported languages
  • Identify recurring problems and collaborate with product & engineering teams to drive root-cause fixes
  • Work with our AI support bot to improve automated deflection and response accuracy
  • Ensure smooth shift handovers and maintain excellent team coordination
  • Track, observe and analyze Customer Experience metrics to help shape the design of our product and service


Requirements


Must-have:

  • Professional working proficiency in English (written and verbal)
  • Full professional proficiency in Spanish + Portuguese (written and verbal)
  • Previous customer support experience in fintech, crypto, payments, or banking
  • Hands-on experience with helpdesk tools (Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom, or similar)
  • Strong attention to detail and excellent written communication skills
  • Availability and flexibility for shift work to cover time zones (including some evenings or weekends depending on the assigned shift), and emergency/standby cover for critical items


Nice-to-have:

  • Experience with KYC/AML processes or compliance-related support
  • Familiarity with crypto wallets, blockchain transactions, or Web3 applications
  • Experience writing help center or knowledge base content
  • Customer experience and service design skills
  • System admin technology skills
  • Written and verbal working proficiency in additional languages is a considerably desirable


What We Offer


  • Great salary for great skills

title: Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a full-time, remote Project Manager with 5+ years of experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives within software and technology organizations. This role is focused on driving multiple concurrent product transition, migration, and implementation projects while coordinating stakeholders across Product, Engineering, IT, Legal, Finance, Operations, and Implementation teams.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in complex environments, excels at managing competing priorities, and can serve as the central point of coordination across numerous workstreams. You will act as the organizational \"control tower,\" ensuring critical initiatives stay on track, dependencies are identified early, risks are mitigated, and teams remain aligned toward shared objectives.

Our client is a leading energy technology company focused on digitizing fuel operations through a single, real-time platform. Their software connects people, equipment, and facilities to provide enterprise-wide visibility and data-driven insights that fuel asset optimization, improve operational efficiency, and help organizations manage risk, maintenance, and fuel logistics more effectively.


Responsibilities

  • Serve as the central coordinator for 15 concurrent projects, including product transitions, implementation initiatives, and product enhancements
  • Drive cross-functional programs involving Product, Engineering, IT, Legal, Finance, Operations, Training, and Implementation teams
  • Develop and maintain program-level roadmaps, timelines, and dependency tracking
  • Ensure legacy product retirement initiatives remain on schedule and aligned with business objectives
  • Coordinate customer transition activities, including internal readiness, legal requirements, implementation planning, and operational processes
  • Partner with IT and Engineering teams to ensure systems, infrastructure, and technical requirements are properly aligned
  • Work closely with Legal and Operations teams to support product migrations, compliance requirements, notifications, and transition planning
  • Track and manage action items across multiple stakeholders and departments
  • Facilitate prioritization discussions and ensure resources remain focused on the highest-impact initiatives
  • Proactively identify project risks and drive resolution before they impact delivery timelines
  • Provide executive-level visibility into program status, blockers, dependencies, and milestones
  • Support implementation and rollout planning to ensure successful adoption of new products and services
  • Collaborate with Scrum Masters, Product Managers, and Engineering teams while maintaining a broader program-level perspective
  • Establish and improve processes for managing large-scale, cross-functional initiatives
  • Drive accountability across teams and ensure commitments are completed on schedule


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in Program Management, Technical Program Management, Project Management, or Product Operations roles
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects in software or technology-focused organizations
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience coordinating work across multiple business functions and departments
  • Ability to identify gaps, dependencies, risks, and process improvements across complex initiatives
  • Strong experience facilitating cross-functional collaboration and driving execution
  • Experience working with software development, product management, and engineering organizations
  • Technical acumen with a solid understanding of software development, infrastructure, and technology concepts
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities
  • Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and maintain accountability across teams
  • Experience operating in fast-paced environments with competing priorities and evolving requirements


Preferred Experience

  • Experience managing product migrations, software implementations, or legacy system retirement programs
  • Experience using Kanban-based project management methodologies
  • Experience working with Product, Engineering, IT, Legal, Finance, and Operations teams
  • Background in SaaS, enterprise software, or technology-driven organizations
  • Experience with portfolio management, program governance, or PMO functions
  • Familiarity with Agile development environments
  • Experience using project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms
  • Experience supporting organizational change management initiatives
  • Experience working in highly cross-functional, matrixed environments


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions. Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: \"Consultor Service Now Pleno #1007845\"
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para \"Consultor Service Now Pleno #1007845\" em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Detalhes do projeto

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor ServiceNow nível Pleno com perfil generalista, capaz de atuar de forma transversal em diferentes frentes da plataforma. O profissional será responsável pela evolução contínua e sustentação do ambiente, contribuindo com melhorias técnicas e funcionais.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento, manutenção e melhoria contínua da plataforma ServiceNow;
  • Trabalhar de forma transversal em módulos como ITSM, CMDB e SPM;
  • Desenvolver soluções utilizando scripts, automações e integrações;
  • Realizar troubleshooting e correção de incidentes/problemas na plataforma;
  • Apoiar o desenho de soluções técnicas alinhadas às necessidades do negócio;
  • Garantir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, documentação e governança.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência prática com desenvolvimento na plataforma ServiceNow, incluindo Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, Flow Designer e Integrações via REST (e desejável SOAP);
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em ITSM, com atuação em Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management e Request Management;
  • Experiência com CMDB (Configuration Management) com Modelagem de classes e atributos de Configuration Items (CIs), Entendimento de relacionamentos e análise de impacto entre serviços
  • Conhecimento em SPM (Strategic Portfolio Management) ou ITBM, incluindo Gestão de portfólio, Projetos e demandas e Experiência com integrações utilizando REST/SOAP e IntegrationHub, Domínio de Flow Designer e boas práticas de desenvolvimento na plataforma.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Certificações ServiceNow (CSA, CAD ou similares)
  • Experiência com governança da plataforma ServiceNow
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos de médio ou grande porte
  • Inglês avançado.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Junior Writer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Junior Writer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Junior Writer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM

About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.


Role Overview

As a Junior Writer, you will be responsible for adapting and localizing English content into portuguese - culturally relevant versions, ensuring narrative consistency, emotional depth, and audience engagement. You will work closely with editorial, production, and AI teams to refine scripts, monitor performance, and enhance content quality across the platform.


Key Responsibilities

1. Content Development & Adaptation

  • Review English show materials (audio/scripts) and prepare localization sheets and concept notes with strong cultural adaptation.
  • Adapt scripts using designated GenAI tools, ensuring proper structuring, tone, and inclusion of emotion tags where required.
  • Review and refine AI-generated translations to ensure alignment with editorial standards, cultural nuances, and narrative integrity.
  • Incorporate editorial and technical feedback to revise and deliver high-quality, polished scripts.
  • Deliver ~300 localized and AI-adapted scripts per month, adhering to timelines and quality benchmarks.


2. Quality Reviews & Continuous Improvement

  • Review published audio episodes and provide structured feedback on AI-generated adaptations.
  • Identify recurring issues in translation, tone, or storytelling and recommend improvements.
  • Analyze user comments and feedback to enhance content quality and relevance.


3. Production Support & Quality Assurance

  • Suggest suitable voice-over artists based on character and project requirements
  • Ensure produced content aligns with creative intent and quality standards
  • Conduct quality checks on production samples and provide actionable feedback to ensure “first-time-right” output.


4. Promotion Support

  • Develop concepts and draft scripts for promotional content (10–60 minutes) aligned with series positioning and storytelling goals


5. AI-Driven Editorial Innovation & Tool Adoption

  • Demonstrate hands-on usage of AI tools to enhance editorial workflows, script development, research, adaptation, and content optimization.
  • Apply strong editorial judgment while leveraging GenAI tools to ensure narrative quality, factual consistency, cultural sensitivity, and platform standards.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, or related
  • Strong storytelling skills with an understanding of narrative structure, character development, and pacing.
  • Familiarity with AI-based writing or content adaptation tools is preferred
  • Experience in content localization, translation review, or scriptwriting is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain consistency across high-volume deliverables.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret user data and feedback.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced content production environment.

title: Quality Assurance Automação
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Quality Assurance Automação em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade imediata para profissional especialista em Qualidade de Softwares com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.


O QA de Automação é o profissional responsável por estruturar, implementar e sustentar a automação de testes ao longo do ciclo de desenvolvimento, assegurando qualidade, rastreabilidade e velocidade nas entregas. Sua atuação vai além da execução técnica: ele contribui para a prevenção de defeitos, fortalecimento da cultura de qualidade e aumento da confiança do time nas releases. Esse papel é especialmente relevante em ambientes com entregas contínuas, múltiplas integrações e necessidade de regressão frequente, pois reduz esforço manual, aumenta a previsibilidade e melhora a estabilidade do produto.


Escopo de atuação

O profissional atua na definição da estratégia de testes automatizados, desenho de cenários críticos, implementação de frameworks, integração com pipelines, análise de falhas, manutenção da suíte de regressão e apoio à evolução das práticas de qualidade do time.



Responsabilidades

  • Implementar, manter e evoluir testes automatizados para aplicações web, APIs e, quando aplicável, fluxos integrados entre sistemas.
  • Participar da análise de requisitos, refinamentos e critérios de aceite, contribuindo com visão preventiva de qualidade desde as etapas iniciais do desenvolvimento.
  • Definir a melhor abordagem de automação para cada contexto, equilibrando cobertura, custo de manutenção, estabilidade e retorno sobre investimento.
  • Integrar a execução dos testes automatizados às pipelines de CI/CD, garantindo feedback rápido e confiável para o time.
  • Estruturar e manter massa de testes, dados de apoio, mocks, stubs e evidências necessárias para execução consistente dos cenários automatizados.
  • Monitorar falhas recorrentes, identificar causas-raiz e atuar em conjunto com desenvolvedores e demais QAs na melhoria contínua da qualidade.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de qualidade, cobertura, tempo de execução, taxa de falhas e efetividade da automação.
  • Apoiar a definição e evolução de padrões, boas práticas, convenções de código e arquitetura dos frameworks de teste.
  • Contribuir com a estratégia de Shift Left, promovendo testes antecipados, prevenção de defeitos e maior colaboração entre QA, desenvolvimento e produto.
  • Documentar cenários, fluxos automatizados, premissas técnicas e limitações da suíte de testes para facilitar reuso e manutenção.



Competências técnicas esperadas

  • Experiência com automação de testes para API e Web.
  • Conhecimento em C# e/ou Python, com boa base de lógica, estruturação de código e manutenção de automações.
  • Vivência com ferramentas e frameworks como Selenium, Robot Framework, ReqNRoll ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência com testes orientados a comportamento, quando aplicável, utilizando BDD para estruturar cenários de negócio.
  • Conhecimento de integração contínua e pipelines de CI/CD para execução automatizada de testes.
  • Experiência com versionamento de código, preferencialmente com Git.
  • Capacidade de elaborar cenários de teste rastreáveis a requisitos e critérios de aceite.
  • Conhecimento de testes funcionais, regressivos, smoke tests e validação de serviços.
  • Conhecimento de consultas a banco de dados para validação de dados e apoio à investigação de defeitos.
  • Leitura e interpretação de logs, evidências e relatórios de execução.



Conhecimentos desejáveis

  • Vivência com ferramentas de observabilidade e dashboards, como Grafana.
  • Experiência com testes de contrato, mocks e virtualização de serviços.
  • Conhecimento de estratégias de qualidade em arquitetura distribuída, microsserviços e integrações.
  • Familiaridade com testes de performance, segurança ou resiliência, mesmo que não seja o foco principal da posição.
  • Vivência com containers, ambientes em nuvem ou orquestração de execução de testes.
  • Conhecimento de métricas de qualidade e governança de testes.


Capacidades esperadas

  • Capacidade de construir suítes de testes automatizados reutilizáveis, legíveis e de fácil manutenção.
  • Capacidade de selecionar cenários com maior retorno para automação, evitando baixa eficiência ou excesso de manutenção.
  • Capacidade de estruturar testes com rastreabilidade entre requisito, cenário, evidência e resultado.
  • Capacidade de integrar testes ao fluxo de entrega contínua, com execução confiável e feedback rápido.
  • Capacidade de diagnosticar falhas de automação, diferenciar falso positivo de defeito real e atuar na estabilização da suíte.
  • Capacidade de colaborar com o time para elevar a maturidade de qualidade e prevenir defeitos desde o início do ciclo.


Requisitos de formação e experiência

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia com qualidade de software, testes automatizados e atuação em times ágeis.
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis, especialmente Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Experiência em interação com times multidisciplinares, incluindo desenvolvimento, produto e QA manual.


Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Ter certificações em testes, qualidade ou automação.
  • Ter experiência em ambientes regulados, sistemas críticos ou produtos com alta necessidade de rastreabilidade.
  • Ter vivência com testes em arquitetura de microsserviços, mensageria, filas ou integrações complexas.
  • Ter atuado na criação de frameworks do zero ou na modernização de esteiras de qualidade.
  • Experiência em projetos de Inteligência Artificial.

  • Contribuir com a estratégia de Shift Left, promovendo testes antecipados, prevenção de defeitos e maior colaboração entre QA, desenvolvimento e produto.
  • Documentar cenários, fluxos automatizados, premissas técnicas e limitações da suíte de testes para facilitar reuso e manutenção.



Competências técnicas esperadas

  • Experiência com automação de testes para API e Web.
  • Conhecimento em C# e/ou Python, com boa base de lógica, estruturação de código e manutenção de automações.
  • Vivência com ferramentas e frameworks como Selenium, Robot Framework, ReqNRoll ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência com testes orientados a comportamento, quando aplicável, utilizando BDD para estruturar cenários de negócio.
  • Conhecimento de integração contínua e pipelines de CI/CD para execução automatizada de testes.
  • Experiência com versionamento de código, preferencialmente com Git.
  • Capacidade de elaborar cenários de teste rastreáveis a requisitos e critérios de aceite.
  • Conhecimento de testes funcionais, regressivos, smoke tests e validação de serviços.
  • Conhecimento de consultas a banco de dados para validação de dados e apoio à investigação de defeitos.
  • Leitura e interpretação de logs, evidências e relatórios de execução.



Conhecimentos desejáveis

  • Vivência com ferramentas de observabilidade e dashboards, como Grafana.
  • Experiência com testes de contrato, mocks e virtualização de serviços.
  • Conhecimento de estratégias de qualidade em arquitetura distribuída, microsserviços e integrações.
  • Familiaridade com testes de performance, segurança ou resiliência, mesmo que não seja o foco principal da posição.
  • Vivência com containers, ambientes em nuvem ou orquestração de execução de testes.
  • Conhecimento de métricas de qualidade e governança de testes.


Capacidades esperadas

  • Capacidade de construir suítes de testes automatizados reutilizáveis, legíveis e de fácil manutenção.
  • Capacidade de selecionar cenários com maior retorno para automação, evitando baixa eficiência ou excesso de manutenção.
  • Capacidade de estruturar testes com rastreabilidade entre requisito, cenário, evidência e resultado.
  • Capacidade de integrar testes ao fluxo de entrega contínua, com execução confiável e feedback rápido.
  • Capacidade de diagnosticar falhas de automação, diferenciar falso positivo de defeito real e atuar na estabilização da suíte.
  • Capacidade de colaborar com o time para elevar a maturidade de qualidade e prevenir defeitos desde o início do ciclo.


Requisitos de formação e experiência

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia com qualidade de software, testes automatizados e atuação em times ágeis.
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis, especialmente Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Experiência em interação com times multidisciplinares, incluindo desenvolvimento, produto e QA manual.


Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Ter certificações em testes, qualidade ou automação.
  • Ter experiência em ambientes regulados, sistemas críticos ou produtos com alta necessidade de rastreabilidade.

title: Junior Writer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Junior Writer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Junior Writer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM

About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.


Role Overview

As a Junior Writer, you will be responsible for adapting and localizing English content into portuguese - culturally relevant versions, ensuring narrative consistency, emotional depth, and audience engagement. You will work closely with editorial, production, and AI teams to refine scripts, monitor performance, and enhance content quality across the platform.


Key Responsibilities

1. Content Development & Adaptation

  • Review English show materials (audio/scripts) and prepare localization sheets and concept notes with strong cultural adaptation.
  • Adapt scripts using designated GenAI tools, ensuring proper structuring, tone, and inclusion of emotion tags where required.
  • Review and refine AI-generated translations to ensure alignment with editorial standards, cultural nuances, and narrative integrity.
  • Incorporate editorial and technical feedback to revise and deliver high-quality, polished scripts.
  • Deliver ~300 localized and AI-adapted scripts per month, adhering to timelines and quality benchmarks.


2. Quality Reviews & Continuous Improvement

  • Review published audio episodes and provide structured feedback on AI-generated adaptations.
  • Identify recurring issues in translation, tone, or storytelling and recommend improvements.
  • Analyze user comments and feedback to enhance content quality and relevance.


3. Production Support & Quality Assurance

  • Suggest suitable voice-over artists based on character and project requirements
  • Ensure produced content aligns with creative intent and quality standards
  • Conduct quality checks on production samples and provide actionable feedback to ensure “first-time-right” output.


4. Promotion Support

  • Develop concepts and draft scripts for promotional content (10–60 minutes) aligned with series positioning and storytelling goals


5. AI-Driven Editorial Innovation & Tool Adoption

  • Demonstrate hands-on usage of AI tools to enhance editorial workflows, script development, research, adaptation, and content optimization.
  • Apply strong editorial judgment while leveraging GenAI tools to ensure narrative quality, factual consistency, cultural sensitivity, and platform standards.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, or related
  • Strong storytelling skills with an understanding of narrative structure, character development, and pacing.
  • Familiarity with AI-based writing or content adaptation tools is preferred
  • Experience in content localization, translation review, or scriptwriting is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain consistency across high-volume deliverables.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret user data and feedback.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced content production environment.

title: Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a full-time, remote Project Manager with 5+ years of experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives within software and technology organizations. This role is focused on driving multiple concurrent product transition, migration, and implementation projects while coordinating stakeholders across Product, Engineering, IT, Legal, Finance, Operations, and Implementation teams.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in complex environments, excels at managing competing priorities, and can serve as the central point of coordination across numerous workstreams. You will act as the organizational \"control tower,\" ensuring critical initiatives stay on track, dependencies are identified early, risks are mitigated, and teams remain aligned toward shared objectives.

Our client is a leading energy technology company focused on digitizing fuel operations through a single, real-time platform. Their software connects people, equipment, and facilities to provide enterprise-wide visibility and data-driven insights that fuel asset optimization, improve operational efficiency, and help organizations manage risk, maintenance, and fuel logistics more effectively.


Responsibilities

  • Serve as the central coordinator for 15 concurrent projects, including product transitions, implementation initiatives, and product enhancements
  • Drive cross-functional programs involving Product, Engineering, IT, Legal, Finance, Operations, Training, and Implementation teams
  • Develop and maintain program-level roadmaps, timelines, and dependency tracking
  • Ensure legacy product retirement initiatives remain on schedule and aligned with business objectives
  • Coordinate customer transition activities, including internal readiness, legal requirements, implementation planning, and operational processes
  • Partner with IT and Engineering teams to ensure systems, infrastructure, and technical requirements are properly aligned
  • Work closely with Legal and Operations teams to support product migrations, compliance requirements, notifications, and transition planning
  • Track and manage action items across multiple stakeholders and departments
  • Facilitate prioritization discussions and ensure resources remain focused on the highest-impact initiatives
  • Proactively identify project risks and drive resolution before they impact delivery timelines
  • Provide executive-level visibility into program status, blockers, dependencies, and milestones
  • Support implementation and rollout planning to ensure successful adoption of new products and services
  • Collaborate with Scrum Masters, Product Managers, and Engineering teams while maintaining a broader program-level perspective
  • Establish and improve processes for managing large-scale, cross-functional initiatives
  • Drive accountability across teams and ensure commitments are completed on schedule


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in Program Management, Technical Program Management, Project Management, or Product Operations roles
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects in software or technology-focused organizations
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience coordinating work across multiple business functions and departments
  • Ability to identify gaps, dependencies, risks, and process improvements across complex initiatives
  • Strong experience facilitating cross-functional collaboration and driving execution
  • Experience working with software development, product management, and engineering organizations
  • Technical acumen with a solid understanding of software development, infrastructure, and technology concepts
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities
  • Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and maintain accountability across teams
  • Experience operating in fast-paced environments with competing priorities and evolving requirements


Preferred Experience

  • Experience managing product migrations, software implementations, or legacy system retirement programs
  • Experience using Kanban-based project management methodologies
  • Experience working with Product, Engineering, IT, Legal, Finance, and Operations teams
  • Background in SaaS, enterprise software, or technology-driven organizations
  • Experience with portfolio management, program governance, or PMO functions
  • Familiarity with Agile development environments
  • Experience using project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms
  • Experience supporting organizational change management initiatives
  • Experience working in highly cross-functional, matrixed environments


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions. Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: User Experience Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para User Experience Designer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Our culture isn’t something people join, it’s something they build and shape. We believe that every person deserves to be heard and empowered. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a fit, we say go for it. Let’s build something great together.



We're looking for a Visual (UX) Designer with exceptional visual design skills to support a large-scale Design System initiative for a leading enterprise software platform. This role is focused on visual exploration, design systems thinking, and crafting polished user interface experiences that can scale across complex products


You'll work closely with an established Design System team to help define and evolve the visual language of the platform. This is a highly collaborative role where you'll explore design directions, create high-fidelity concepts, evaluate design solutions, and help bridge brand expression with scalable system design.


Must Haves

  • 5+ years of experience in UX/UI, Product Design, or Visual Design roles with a strong emphasis on user interface design and visual craft.
  • Outstanding visual design portfolio demonstrating excellence in typography, color systems, spacing, hierarchy, layout, iconography, and interaction design.
  • Experience working within or contributing to design systems, with an understanding of how visual decisions scale across products and experiences.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise software, complex workflows, information-dense interfaces, and interaction patterns.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.1 AA, and experience incorporating accessibility considerations into visual design decisions
  • Comfort working in ambiguous environments, synthesizing inputs, forming design recommendations, and defending design rationale with stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with designers, product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders.


Nice to have

  • Experience working on enterprise SaaS products.
  • Previous involvement in Design System initiatives or component library evolution.
  • Experience conducting competitive visual analysis and translating insights into design recommendations.
  • Familiarity with Material UI (MUI) or other enterprise design system frameworks.



Key Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with the Design System team to explore and define future visual directions for enterprise software products.
  • Explore, iterate, and refine visual design directions across areas such as color, typography, spacing, elevation, iconography, and overall product aesthetics.
  • Create high-fidelity design concepts and prototypes that demonstrate how visual design decisions apply across real product workflows and use cases.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable visual patterns that can be incorporated into the broader Design System.
  • Support design evaluation activities by preparing assets, prototypes, and presentation materials for stakeholder reviews and user feedback sessions.

description:

Our culture isn’t something people join, it’s something they build and shape. We believe that every person deserves to be heard and empowered. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a fit, we say go for it. Let’s build something great together.



We're looking for a Visual (UX) Designer with exceptional visual design skills to support a large-scale Design System initiative for a leading enterprise software platform. This role is focused on visual exploration, design systems thinking, and crafting polished user interface experiences that can scale across complex products


You'll work closely with an established Design System team to help define and evolve the visual language of the platform.
