Must Haves

  • 5+ years of experience in UX/UI, Product Design, or Visual Design roles with a strong emphasis on user interface design and visual craft.

Nice to have

  • Experience working on enterprise SaaS products.
  • Previous involvement in Design System initiatives or component library evolution.
  • Experience conducting competitive visual analysis and translating insights into design recommendations.
  • Familiarity with Material UI (MUI) or other enterprise design system frameworks.



Key Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with the Design System team to explore and define future visual directions for enterprise software products.
  • Explore, iterate, and refine visual design directions across areas such as color, typography, spacing, elevation, iconography, and overall product aesthetics.
  • Create high-fidelity design concepts and prototypes that demonstrate how visual design decisions apply across real product workflows and use cases.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para .Net Senior Developer (Brazil) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

What makes us different?

Your next adventure starts here!

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Spanish and Portuguese speaking customer support em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us


You will be working on customer support for a modern blockchain-based neo-banking app. Exciting opportunity to work with the greatest Blockchain companies.


The Role


As one of our first Customer Support Specialists, you will be the face of our neo-banking app and the primary point of contact for our users.

This is a fully remote position with shift-based scheduling to ensure proper coverage across multiple time zones. You will work in coordination with the other support specialist to provide responsive support during peak user hours.

You’ll handle inbound support, help users resolve issues quickly, and help shape our customer support experience, knowledge base, and processes from the ground up. High performers will have clear growth opportunities into Customer Experience Design, Service Design, and Quality Assurance roles as the team expands.


What You’ll Do


  • Provide high-quality support via tickets, live chat, and email for users
  • Help maintain and improve customer support software
  • Influence the design of our customer experience
  • Help define and refine our customer support processes
  • Guide users through KYC verification, onboarding, payments, account issues, and transaction queries, through guides and ticket support where necessary
  • Strictly follow compliance procedures, particularly around account restrictions, transaction disputes, and regulatory requirements
  • Create, maintain, and continuously improve help center articles in your supported languages
  • Identify recurring problems and collaborate with product & engineering teams to drive root-cause fixes
  • Work with our AI support bot to improve automated deflection and response accuracy
  • Ensure smooth shift handovers and maintain excellent team coordination
  • Track, observe and analyze Customer Experience metrics to help shape the design of our product and service


Requirements


Must-have:

  • Professional working proficiency in English (written and verbal)
  • Full professional proficiency in Spanish + Portuguese (written and verbal)
  • Previous customer support experience in fintech, crypto, payments, or banking
  • Hands-on experience with helpdesk tools (Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom, or similar)
  • Strong attention to detail and excellent written communication skills
  • Availability and flexibility for shift work to cover time zones (including some evenings or weekends depending on the assigned shift), and emergency/standby cover for critical items


Nice-to-have:

  • Experience with KYC/AML processes or compliance-related support

  • Experience writing help center or knowledge base content
  • Customer experience and service design skills
  • System admin technology skills
  • Written and verbal working proficiency in additional languages is a considerably desirable

  • Great salary for great skills

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Digital Marketing Director em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

SPOKEN ENGLISH IS A MUST!

*Please make sure to submit your resume in English; it will not be accepted otherwise. The interview process will also be conducted in English.


Digital Marketing Director

Location: Remote


About Us:

Smart Age Solutions is a leading digital marketing and technology agency specializing in the jewelry industry. We help some of the most recognized jewelry retailers and luxury brands grow through cutting-edge digital strategies, including SEO, Paid Media, Social Media, Email Marketing, Web Development, Conversion Optimization, AI-driven marketing solutions, and eCommerce.


With team members across the United States and Latin America, we combine deep industry expertise with innovation, data, and technology to deliver measurable growth for our clients.


As we continue to scale, we are seeking an experienced Marketing Director to lead our marketing organization, oversee department leadership, and help shape the future of our agency.



Role Overview

The Digital Marketing Director will serve as a senior leader within the company, responsible for overseeing the performance, strategy, and development of multiple marketing departments.

This role is not responsible for executing campaigns directly. Instead, the Marketing Director will lead and develop department managers across SEO, Paid Media, Social Media, Design, Copywriting, Content, and Marketing Operations while ensuring alignment, accountability, operational efficiency, and client success.


The ideal candidate is a proven marketing leader with agency experience, strong business acumen, exceptional people management skills, and a deep understanding of modern digital marketing strategies, analytics, automation, AI, and performance marketing.

This individual will play a critical role in scaling Smart Age Solutions while maintaining the quality, innovation, and results that define our brand.



Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute the company's overall marketing vision and departmental strategy.
  • Align marketing initiatives with company growth objectives, revenue goals, retention targets, and client success metrics.
  • Establish department-wide KPIs, accountability systems, and performance standards.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and profitability.


Department Leadership

  • Manage and mentor department managers across:
  • SEO
  • Paid Media (Google Ads, Meta Ads, Programmatic)
  • Social Media
  • Design & Creative
  • Copywriting & Content
  • Marketing Operations
  • Create clear growth paths, coaching programs, and professional development plans for leaders and team members.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.


Performance & Analytics

  • Establish and monitor KPIs across all service lines.
  • Analyze performance trends and identify opportunities for optimization.
  • Drive data-informed decision-making throughout the organization.
  • Ensure departments are delivering measurable results for clients.
  • Oversee reporting frameworks, dashboards, forecasting, and performance reviews.


Client Strategy & Growth

  • Partner with Account Management and Executive Leadership to support high-level client strategy.
  • Participate in key client meetings and executive reviews when strategic leadership is required.
  • Help identify opportunities for account growth, retention, and improved client outcomes.
  • Ensure marketing strategies align with client business goals and industry best practices.


Innovation & Technology

  • Champion the adoption of AI, automation, and emerging marketing technologies.
  • Evaluate new platforms, tools, and technologies that improve efficiency and results.
  • Drive innovation initiatives across departments.
  • Help position our company as a leader in digital marketing within the jewelry industry.


Operational Excellence

  • Improve workflows, processes, SOPs, and cross-department collaboration.
  • Ensure departments are properly staffed, resourced, and structured for growth.
  • Work closely with executive leadership to forecast hiring needs and organizational development.
  • Assist in building scalable systems that support the company's long-term growth strategy.


Financial Management

  • Monitor departmental performance against revenue and profitability goals.
  • Assist with resource allocation, budgeting, forecasting, and capacity planning.
  • Ensure efficient utilization of team resources while maintaining service quality.



Qualifications

Required

  • Fluent English, written and verbal communication skills.
  • 8+ years of digital marketing experience.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing managers and multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Proven success leading teams across SEO, Paid Media, Social Media, Content, and Creative.
  • Strong understanding of performance marketing, analytics, attribution, conversion optimization, and customer acquisition strategies.
  • Experience working within a digital marketing agency environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to build, scale, and optimize high-performing teams.
  • Strong business, operational, and financial acumen.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and leadership skills.
  • Experience managing KPIs, forecasting, reporting, and strategic planning.


Preferred

  • Experience in eCommerce, luxury, retail, or jewelry industries.
  • Experience implementing AI and automation solutions within marketing operations.
  • Experience with platforms such as:
  • Google Analytics 4
  • Google Ads
  • Meta Ads Manager
  • HubSpot
  • Shopify
  • Looker Studio
  • SEMrush
  • Whatagraph
  • Asana, ClickUp, Monday, Jira, or similar project management platforms
  • MBA or Master's Degree in Marketing, Business, or related field.



What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means:

  • Building high-performing department leaders.
  • Improving efficiency and collaboration across teams.
  • Driving measurable improvements in client performance and retention.
  • Scaling processes, systems, and team structures.
  • Introducing innovation and AI-driven solutions.
  • Helping the company continue its growth as a leading digital marketing agency.



Why Join Our Team?

  • Work with some of the most recognized jewelry retailers and luxury brands in North America.
  • Lead a talented and growing team of digital marketing professionals.
  • Opportunity to shape the future direction of a rapidly growing agency.
  • Collaborative, entrepreneurial, and innovation-driven culture.
  • Remote-first work environment with global collaboration.


We believe exceptional talent comes from diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all qualified candidates are welcomed and encouraged to apply.

We're excited to learn about your experience, leadership style, and vision for building world-class marketing teams.

title: ML/AI Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para ML/AI Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ML/AI Engineer (Databricks)


Location: Remote (Brazil) | Type: Contract | Experience: 3 to 5+ years

About the Role


We're hiring an ML/AI Engineer to build and ship machine learning and AI systems on top of a modern Databricks data platform. You'll work close to the data, turning messy enterprise sources into features, models, and AI-powered applications that run reliably in production rather than living in a notebook.


The client is a data and AI platform company that modernizes how energy and heavy-industry enterprises work with their data, migrating legacy systems onto Databricks and the lakehouse and then building intelligence on top of it. The work is hands-on and full-lifecycle: you'll touch pipelines, models, and the services that put predictions in front of real users.


This role suits someone who likes living at the seam between data engineering and ML. If you've shipped models that depend on real pipelines holding up, and you want to do that work on a clean Databricks stack instead of fighting infrastructure, you'll feel at home here.


What You'll Do

  • Build, train, and validate ML models on Databricks, with real attention to evaluation, generalization, and where the model will actually be used
  • Engineer features and data transformations in Spark and SQL from enterprise sources that are rarely tidy
  • Stand up MLflow-based workflows for experiment tracking, model registry, and reproducible training runs
  • Deploy models as batch jobs or real-time endpoints, then keep them honest with monitoring for drift, latency, and cost
  • Partner with data engineers on the lakehouse layer so the data feeding your models is reliable and well-modeled
  • Bring LLM and retrieval techniques into the mix where they fit the problem, and skip them where they don't
  • Apply solid engineering habits throughout: version control, testing, code review, CI/CD


Qualifications

  • 3 to 5+ years building ML or AI systems in production, with strong Python fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks, including Spark and Delta Lake (Azure Databricks is a plus)
  • Comfort across the ML lifecycle: feature engineering, training, validation, deployment, and monitoring
  • Working knowledge of MLflow or a comparable experiment tracking and model registry tool
  • Strong SQL and a real understanding of how data pipelines feed models
  • Exposure to LLM-powered or retrieval-based applications, or genuine curiosity to grow into them
  • Professional working English, since collaboration happens across a distributed team


Why Join Us

You'll join a small, senior team that has been steadily building out a Databricks-based platform for demanding enterprise clients, where the data is complex and the standards for what ships are high. The work is remote and async-friendly, and your models won't sit on a shelf; they go into systems people actually depend on.


If you want ownership over real ML work on a clean, modern stack, with teammates who care about doing it right, this is a strong fit.


To apply, click Apply on LinkedIn and visit eliosai.com/browse-jobs

title: Senior AI Architect, GenAI & Document Intelligence
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior AI Architect, GenAI & Document Intelligence em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Alyra Technology builds AI-enabled software and automation systems for document-heavy, regulated industries: insurance, legal, finance and healthcare. We pair modern Microsoft Azure architecture with applied generative AI to ship systems that are explainable, auditable and production-ready, not demos. Our work centers on pulling structure, meaning and decisions out of complex, unstructured documents at scale.

Role Description

We're hiring a senior Azure architect who's designed production GenAI systems for messy, real-world documents, and done it for years. Contracts, filings, policies, medical records, financial statements. If you've bolted GPT onto a web app, this isn't your role. If you've built production GenAI pipelines for document-heavy, regulated work, keep reading.

This role is architecture-first. You'll turn ambiguous AI ideas into clear, defensible system designs covering data flows, agent interactions, retrieval pipelines, security boundaries and auditability, primarily on Microsoft Azure. We pull you in as projects launch, so the cadence flexes with the work, lighter in steady stretches and heavier during active builds.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years designing and shipping production AI systems, not just prototyping them
  • 5+ years working directly with unstructured text and document-centric AI. This is non-negotiable.
  • Proven production RAG, multi-agent or document intelligence pipelines at real-world complexity
  • Deep, hands-on Azure platform experience, end to end
  • A real understanding of how GenAI fails in production: hallucination, retrieval quality, context limits, latency and cost at scale
  • Ability to design for auditability and explainability in compliance-sensitive environments
  • 7+ years total software or platform engineering experience
  • Located in Brazil, with professional English, written and spoken

Preferred Qualifications  

  • Hands-on with complex multi-page documents: contracts, legal filings, medical records, financial statements, insurance forms or regulatory submissions 
  • Layout-aware parsing tools such as Azure Document Intelligence, Unstructured or LayoutLM
  • Document-grounded output systems where every answer traces back to a specific source passage or page 
  • Client-facing architecture experience in insurance, legal, finance or healthcare 
  • Comfort working alongside AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code

How To Apply

Submit your resume in English.

title: Consultor SAP Data Migration - Viagens Mensais
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor SAP Data Migration - Viagens Mensais em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

O que procuramos?

Buscamos um profissional de SAP Data Migration com perfil analítico, resiliente e proativo para atuar em um dos projetos mais estratégicos do nosso portfólio: o rollout global de migração do SAP ECC para o S/4HANA. O perfil ideal deve estar confortável em transitar por ambientes de alta complexidade técnica e funcional. O maior desafio será atuar como facilitador na transição de uma cultura de sistema altamente customizado (ECC) para a aderência ao template global (S/4HANA), garantindo a integridade dos dados enquanto lida com as particularidades da localização Brasil e os impactos da reforma tributária. Se você possui facilidade de comunicação em inglês e expertise em grandes volumes de dados, essa vaga é para você.

Atribuições principais:

Sólida experiência em projetos de migração de dados SAP (Data Migration). · Conhecimento técnico em ferramentas de migração como SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit (LTMC/LTMOM), LSMW ou SAP BODS. · Vivência prévia em projetos de Rollout e/ou conversão para S/4HANA. · Entendimento das estruturas de dados e tabelas do SAP ECC e S/4HANA. · Experiência com Localização Brasil (impostos, notas fiscais, requisitos legais). · Capacidade de lidar com ambientes complexos, múltiplos landscapes e sistemas altamente customizados.

Requisitos:

Executar o ciclo completo de migração de dados (extração, transformação, carga e validação) do SAP ECC para o S/4HANA. · Realizar o mapeamento de campos (Field Mapping) entre o sistema legado customizado e o novo template global. · Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os donos de processos (BPOs) para garantir que as regras de negócio sejam refletidas na migração. · Garantir o saneamento e a qualidade dos dados (Data Cleansing) antes da carga no ambiente produtivo. · Apoiar a adaptação da localização Brasil dentro do contexto global, considerando as exigências fiscais atuais e futuras (Reforma Tributária). · Participar de reuniões diárias e workshops com times globais utilizando o idioma inglês.

Diferenciais:

Conhecimento profundo em SAP Data Services (BODS). · Certificação SAP S/4HANA. · Entendimento preliminar dos impactos da Reforma Tributária brasileira no ambiente SAP. · Experiência anterior em projetos com metodologia SAP Activate. · Habilidade em lidar com gestão de mudanças (Change Management) técnica junto ao cliente.

Formato de atuação: Remoto com viagens para MG

Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade de interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. title: Declaration Drafter - Immigration
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Declaration Drafter - Immigration em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who Are We?


Bueno Law is a trailblazing immigration law firm focused on empowering the Latin American LGBTQ+ community, survivors of domestic violence, victims of human trafficking, and other vulnerable individuals. We provide life-changing legal services to immigrants in the United States, and we’re looking for passionate, people-first individuals to join our remote team.


We specialize in:


  • Removal Defense (EOIR).
  • Asylum & Humanitarian Relief (U/T visas, VAWA, SIJS).
  • Family‑Based Immigration.

Your Role as a Declaration Drafter


We are looking for an immigration declaration drafter to join our team of Warriors. We do not require experience; we offer a full training program. The ideal candidate is 100% fluent in English and Portuguese, has excellent writing and communication skills, is detail-oriented and a self-starter. Experience in the Psychological or Social Services field. Must be able to work well with different cultures and languages. We require a positive attitude and someone who strives for finding solutions instead of obstacles. We would like the new Warrior to be able to commit full-time to this position (9am-6pm PST).


Who we are looking for:


  • Experience in providing psychological or social services
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Portuguese
  • Ability to Multi-Task
  • Strong Analytical Skills
  • Decision-Making ability
  • Strong Research Skills
  • Team Player
  • Excellent Customer Service Skills
  • Highly organized individual
  • Fast learner
  • Honest
  • Excellent time management skills
  • Must match our growth and improvement mindset and help implement efficiency techniques
  • Reliable and dependable
  • Hardworking 


Essential Duties And Responsibilities:


  • Schedule appointments and maintain calendars.
  • Write and edit documents from letters to reports and instructional documents.
  • Create and maintain filing systems, both electronic and physical.
  • Handle daily client communications.
  • Maintains filing systems as assigned.
  • Retrieves information as requested from records, email, minutes, and other related documents; prepares written summaries of data when needed.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.


What We Offer:


  • Competitive pay above market rate.
  • Paid vacation + sick leave.
  • Your birthday off.
  • U.S. paid holidays.
  • Mon–Fri, 9 AM–6 PM PST.
  • A mission‑driven, inclusive, supportive team.

Send your resume to with the position in the subject line.

Applications submitted through LinkedIn will not be reviewed.

title: Head of Compliance, Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Compliance, Brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Head of Compliance & MLRO to oversee the company's compliance and regulatory responsibilities in Brazil. This role will support the business in maintaining a strong compliance culture, managing regulatory relationships, and ensuring alignment with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.


Working closely with local and regional stakeholders, the successful candidate will provide practical compliance guidance while supporting the company's growth and licensing initiatives in Brazil.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the designated MLRO and lead compliance representative for the Brazil business.
  • Oversee the company's compliance, AML/CFT, sanctions, and financial crime programs.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and provide guidance on relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain relationships with regulators and support regulatory enquiries, reviews, and examinations.
  • Support licensing, registration, and other regulatory initiatives as required.
  • Provide compliance advice to business and operational teams on new products, services, and business activities.
  • Help ensure policies, procedures, and controls remain effective and aligned with regulatory expectations.
  • Oversee key compliance processes, including customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Identify compliance risks and work with stakeholders to implement appropriate controls and solutions.
  • Prepare compliance updates and reporting for management.
  • Deliver compliance training and promote a strong culture of compliance across the organization.
  • Collaborate with regional and global teams on compliance-related matters.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Experience in Compliance, AML/Financial Crime, Regulatory Affairs, or a related function within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or digital assets.
  • Prior experience as an MLRO, Compliance Officer, or similar compliance role is preferred.
  • Good understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements and AML/CFT obligations.
  • Experience interacting with regulators, auditors, or other external stakeholders is advantageous.
  • Exposure to licensing, regulatory approvals, or compliance projects is beneficial.
  • Experience within digital assets, fintech, payments, or financial institutions is preferred.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a dynamic and evolving environment.
  • Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, CFE, or equivalent are a plus.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.


Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.


OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

O foco da posição está na construção de arquiteturas seguras, operação de plataformas de detecção e resposta a ameaças, proteção de dados, gestão de postura de segurança e fortalecimento dos controles de identidade e produtividade corporativa.

Atuar como especialista técnico em soluções de segurança Google Cloud, liderando definições arquiteturais e boas práticas de segurança. 

Projetar, implementar e evoluir ambientes de segurança utilizando as soluções nativas do Google Cloud Security. 

Liderar iniciativas relacionadas a monitoramento, detecção de ameaças, resposta a incidentes e operações de segurança utilizando Google SecOps (Chronicle). 

Implementar e otimizar controles de segurança para ambientes Google Cloud, Google Workspace e Chrome Enterprise. 

Desenhar e implementar estratégias de proteção de dados utilizando Google Cloud DLP.

title: SAP Consultant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para SAP Consultant em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contractor (PJ)

Rate - 25 - 40hr USD - depending on experience


Must Haves

· 7+ years of experience as an SAP Functional Consultant / Business Partner (SAP R/3 is what they are migrating to)

· Strong expertise across FICO (Finance ), MM (Procurement ), and WM (Warehouse Management)

· Experience supporting manufacturing environments, ideally in medical device, pharma, or other regulated industries

· Proven experience in ERP transformations, migrations, or legacy system replacements

· Strong background in business process redesign, solution design, and requirements gathering

· Experience working closely with technical teams (ABAP, integrations, etc.)

· Ability to engage stakeholders across plant operations, supply chain, and finance teams


Overview

We are seeking an experienced SAP Functional Business Partner to support the transition from legacy ERP systems to SAP R/3 across multiple medical device manufacturing sites.

This role is highly business-facing and consultative, focused on partnering with site stakeholders to understand current processes, drive standardization, and design future-state SAP solutions. The individual will act as a bridge between manufacturing operations, business teams, and IT, providing functional direction to technical teams throughout the transformation.

This is not a hands-on configuration role—it is focused on process design, solution definition, and stakeholder partnership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a business partner to manufacturing sites, including supply chain and IT teams
  • Support the transition from legacy ERP systems to SAP R/3, ensuring alignment to business and operational needs
  • Lead current-state assessments and future-state process design across plant operations
  • Facilitate workshops and discovery sessions to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for standardization
  • Define SAP-aligned solutions that meet both business requirements and regulatory considerations
  • Translate business requirements into clear functional specifications for technical (ABAP/integration) teams
  • Provide ongoing guidance to technical teams during solution design and build phases
  • Ensure alignment across Finance (FICO), Procurement (MM), and Warehouse Management (WM) processes
  • Support testing, validation, and deployment activities, particularly within regulated manufacturing environments
  • Drive adoption of best practices and simplified, standardized processes across sites

title: Customer Success Agent (Technical, 24/7 Operations)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Agent (Technical, 24/7 Operations) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

TG Lab is a technology company powering some of the biggest winners in sports betting and online casino products. We provide player account management and engagement technology to industry leaders such as Stake.com, Belgium National Lottery, Betsson Group, and many others. Our innovative yet practical solutions fuel world-class real-money wagering technology that supports over 1 million players. Our iGaming software is designed for distribution to casino and sportsbook operators across the EU, LatAm, and Asia.


We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager (Technical) to join our 24/7 operations team. Our Customer Success team operates at the core of platform stability, partner communication, and incident handling. In this role, you’ll work on the frontline monitoring platform health, investigating issues, and coordinating real-time responses to ensure stable and reliable operations for our partners. This role is about real-time reaction, investigation, coordination, and clear communication.


Responsibilities:  


  • Actively monitor platform health and alerts during your shift and react to incidents in real time
  • Investigate partner-raised issues and perform first-level technical analysis using logs and monitoring dashboards
  • Communicate clearly with partners during incidents, outages, and escalations
  • Own issues throughout their full life cycle: detection, investigation, coordination, and resolution
  • Create and manage Jira tickets and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams
  • Provide transparent updates internally and externally
  • Identify recurring issues and risks that may impact platform stability
  • Maintain accurate documentation and structured internal communication


What will make you successful in this role? 


  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a logical and structured approach to investigating issues
  • Ability to remain calm, focused, and effective in a fast-paced, high-responsibility environment
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to drive issues through to resolution
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Technically curious and comfortable working with system behavior, logs, monitoring tools, and technical workflows
  • Ability to work shift-based schedules, including nights, weekends, and holidays, as part of a 24/7 operation
  • Early-career to mid-level professional with strong growth potential and a proactive mindset


The following would be considered an advantage: 


  • Experience in Customer Support, Customer Success, Technical Support, NOC, or Operations
  • Experience or familiarity with Jira, Slack, or similar collaboration and operational tools
  • Experience with monitoring tools
  • Exposure to SaaS, platform-based products, or iGaming
  • Basic understanding of web technologies, APIs, or backend systems


Working with us implies:


  • Memorable company parties and social activities like team buildings and monthly birthday celebrations.
  • Working in a company with a global culture, experience, and reach.
  • Working on-site in our modern, bright, and comfortable office space located in downtown Foz do Iguaçu, with a great working atmosphere, a collaborative team of amazing people, and open-minded managers.
  • Opportunities to build valuable skills, work with unique and interesting projects for the igaming industry, express and implement your ideas and grow your career.


The monthly salary range will depend on the selected candidate's experience and skills.

We will contact only shortlisted candidates.

title: Quality Assurance Automação
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Quality Assurance Automação em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade imediata para profissional especialista em Qualidade de Softwares com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.


O QA de Automação é o profissional responsável por estruturar, implementar e sustentar a automação de testes ao longo do ciclo de desenvolvimento, assegurando qualidade, rastreabilidade e velocidade nas entregas. Sua atuação vai além da execução técnica: ele contribui para a prevenção de defeitos, fortalecimento da cultura de qualidade e aumento da confiança do time nas releases. Esse papel é especialmente relevante em ambientes com entregas contínuas, múltiplas integrações e necessidade de regressão frequente, pois reduz esforço manual, aumenta a previsibilidade e melhora a estabilidade do produto.


Escopo de atuação

O profissional atua na definição da estratégia de testes automatizados, desenho de cenários críticos, implementação de frameworks, integração com pipelines, análise de falhas, manutenção da suíte de regressão e apoio à evolução das práticas de qualidade do time.



Responsabilidades

  • Implementar, manter e evoluir testes automatizados para aplicações web, APIs e, quando aplicável, fluxos integrados entre sistemas.
  • Participar da análise de requisitos, refinamentos e critérios de aceite, contribuindo com visão preventiva de qualidade desde as etapas iniciais do desenvolvimento.
  • Definir a melhor abordagem de automação para cada contexto, equilibrando cobertura, custo de manutenção, estabilidade e retorno sobre investimento.
  • Integrar a execução dos testes automatizados às pipelines de CI/CD, garantindo feedback rápido e confiável para o time.
  • Estruturar e manter massa de testes, dados de apoio, mocks, stubs e evidências necessárias para execução consistente dos cenários automatizados.
  • Monitorar falhas recorrentes, identificar causas-raiz e atuar em conjunto com desenvolvedores e demais QAs na melhoria contínua da qualidade.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de qualidade, cobertura, tempo de execução, taxa de falhas e efetividade da automação.
  • Apoiar a definição e evolução de padrões, boas práticas, convenções de código e arquitetura dos frameworks de teste.
  • Contribuir com a estratégia de Shift Left, promovendo testes antecipados, prevenção de defeitos e maior colaboração entre QA, desenvolvimento e produto.
  • Documentar cenários, fluxos automatizados, premissas técnicas e limitações da suíte de testes para facilitar reuso e manutenção.



Competências técnicas esperadas

  • Experiência com automação de testes para API e Web.
  • Conhecimento em C# e/ou Python, com boa base de lógica, estruturação de código e manutenção de automações.
  • Vivência com ferramentas e frameworks como Selenium, Robot Framework, ReqNRoll ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência com testes orientados a comportamento, quando aplicável, utilizando BDD para estruturar cenários de negócio.
  • Conhecimento de integração contínua e pipelines de CI/CD para execução automatizada de testes.
  • Experiência com versionamento de código, preferencialmente com Git.
  • Capacidade de elaborar cenários de teste rastreáveis a requisitos e critérios de aceite.
  • Conhecimento de testes funcionais, regressivos, smoke tests e validação de serviços.
  • Conhecimento de consultas a banco de dados para validação de dados e apoio à investigação de defeitos.
  • Leitura e interpretação de logs, evidências e relatórios de execução.



Conhecimentos desejáveis

  • Vivência com ferramentas de observabilidade e dashboards, como Grafana.
  • Experiência com testes de contrato, mocks e virtualização de serviços.
  • Conhecimento de estratégias de qualidade em arquitetura distribuída, microsserviços e integrações.
  • Familiaridade com testes de performance, segurança ou resiliência, mesmo que não seja o foco principal da posição.
  • Vivência com containers, ambientes em nuvem ou orquestração de execução de testes.
  • Conhecimento de métricas de qualidade e governança de testes.


Capacidades esperadas

  • Capacidade de construir suítes de testes automatizados reutilizáveis, legíveis e de fácil manutenção.
  • Capacidade de selecionar cenários com maior retorno para automação, evitando baixa eficiência ou excesso de manutenção.
  • Capacidade de estruturar testes com rastreabilidade entre requisito, cenário, evidência e resultado.
  • Capacidade de integrar testes ao fluxo de entrega contínua, com execução confiável e feedback rápido.
  • Capacidade de diagnosticar falhas de automação, diferenciar falso positivo de defeito real e atuar na estabilização da suíte.
  • Capacidade de colaborar com o time para elevar a maturidade de qualidade e prevenir defeitos desde o início do ciclo.


Requisitos de formação e experiência

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia com qualidade de software, testes automatizados e atuação em times ágeis.
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis, especialmente Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Experiência em interação com times multidisciplinares, incluindo desenvolvimento, produto e QA manual.


Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Ter certificações em testes, qualidade ou automação.
  • Ter experiência em ambientes regulados, sistemas críticos ou produtos com alta necessidade de rastreabilidade.
  • Ter vivência com testes em arquitetura de microsserviços, mensageria, filas ou integrações complexas.
  • Ter atuado na criação de frameworks do zero ou na modernização de esteiras de qualidade.
  • Experiência em projetos de Inteligência Artificial.

title: AI / ML Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI / ML Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a remote, full-time AI / ML Engineer with 4+ years of machine learning experience, preferably within MarTech SaaS companies, to join the engineering team of our U.S. client. You will join our client's innovative, growing team on a mission to unleash the power of culture for growing organizational brands at a time of global, seismic cultural transformation.

You will work with the AI / ML Manager on the Data Science team, developing agentic AI workflows with customized hybrid retrieval and contextual pipelines. The right candidate will have the opportunity to develop a wide range of machine learning and AI techniques to create features for the client's UI / UX and internal tools. You will work collaboratively with, and be a key member of, the research and development team, collaborating closely with software engineers, research teams, and product design, creating novel methods for automating the generation of these data-driven insights from PoC all the way to deployment at scale within the client platform.

If you are a self-starter who enjoys a fast-paced, dynamic, and autonomous environment as well as thrive in challenging situations, then you are the right person for the job. The ideal candidate must collaborate well within a team, leverage strong Generative AI and Machine Learning expertise, and adeptly apply and adapt existing code, innovating new approaches needed to deliver on insights.

Our client unleashes the power of culture, driving brand growth with consumer insights, analytics, tools, and best practices for over 250 major U.S. brands. Its solutions are fueled by its cultural intelligence platform, which allows its customers to more effectively and efficiently understand, reach, and engage consumers, activating them across race, ethnicity, generation, gender, and sexual identity.

Our client comprises creative, analytical, diverse, hardworking, and fun individuals with an insatiable curiosity for the new collage of behaviors and patterns driving consumers today. The possibilities of the moment and opportunity to help organizations unlock their cultural capacity inspire them to seek out predictive insights and brand impacts that are unique to their model.


Responsibilities

  • Develop a wide range of data science techniques, including supervised and unsupervised learning, dimensionality reduction, network analyses, natural language processing, statistical analyses, classification, and similarity modelling.
  • Partner with product and engineering teams to execute in an Agile development environment.
  • Research market trends and innovations in data technologies and analytical approaches to drive innovation while facilitating data platform scalability
  • Develop features with LLMs, VLMs, and ViTs that enable analysis, summarization, and production-ready output of content using the client's internal research data.
  • Develop and maintain strong retrieval augmented generation pipelines with customized time sensitivity, hybrid search methods, and weighting.
  • Develop REST API Endpoints to allow the application's backend to service from the client's AI workflows, maintaining and monitoring token expenditure, latency, and related metrics.
  • Experience with prompt engineering for complex and multi-agent pipelines efficiently, ensuring regression compatibility and with guardrails for hallucination.
  • Develop and design integrations and MCPs with both unstructured and structured data into efficient tools used by AI Agents.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 4+ years of professional experience as a data scientist, preferably in the marketing area
  • 4+ years of relevant work experience in a machine learning or data science role; experience specifically in consumer advertising and marketing or social media is a plus
  • Strong Python skills and/or other platforms and languages (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, SQL, R) and Python libraries
  • Business experience solving analytical issues through quantitative approaches and machine learning methods, as well as experience using advanced statistical methods, data mining techniques, and information retrieval
  • Experience in applying data science methodologies to solve problems, particularly in the marketing domain
  • Experience working with AI and machine learning for product development with LiteLLM, CrewAI, Langchain, Langraph, and similar wrappers.
  • Experience working with AI observability, tracing, spans, and tools tracking (DataDog Observability, Langfuse, Langchain, Arize, or others)
  • Knowledge of probability and statistics (e.g., distributions, hypothesis testing, time series concepts, Bayesian framework)
  • Truly a team player: likes to work with others to get a clear understanding of the context around the data; can happily interact with extraverted thinkers; and can adapt to new information
  • High comfort in analyzing and manipulating large, complex, high-dimensional data from numerous sources
  • Experience working in a cloud environment (AWS preferred)
  • Curiosity and passion for learning
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Advanced university degree (master's degree or equivalent degree) in computer science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, physics, econometrics, or equivalent quantitative fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. simultaneously

title: Líder (a) SAP BW Hana - Remoto
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Líder (a) SAP BW Hana - Remoto em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


The SAP BW Lead will be responsible for leading end to end SAP BW initiatives, including architecture, design, development, migration, and operational support across SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA landscapes. The role will also own real time and near real time data replication using SAP SLT, ensure performant analytics leveraging Native HANA modeling, and act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams.

This is a hands on leadership role requiring deep technical expertise as well as team and delivery ownership.


Key Responsibilities:


Advanced English


• Lead design and implementation of SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA solutions including modeling, data acquisition, transformations, and reporting layers.


• Define and govern BW architecture standards, object reuse strategy, naming conventions, transport strategy, and performance benchmarks.


• Own delivery across implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support engagements.

Data Acquisition & Integration (SLT Focus)


• Design and manage real time and delta data replication from SAP ECC / SAP S/4HANA to BW using SAP SLT.


• Ensure optimal data flow design covering ODP, SLT, and standard extractors, with reconciliation and monitoring frameworks.


• Work closely with Basis and source system teams to ensure stable and scalable replication setups.


SAP BW Modeling & Transformations:


o InfoObjects, ADSOs (Field based & InfoObject based)


o Composite Providers, Open ODS Views


o Transformations, DTPs, Process Chains


Design and optimize Native HANA objects, including:


o Calculation Views, Table Functions, SQL Script procedures

o CDS Views (where applicable)

• Leverage push down logic to HANA to improve query and load performance.


• Collaborate with BW and HANA teams to decide optimal BW vs Native HANA modeling strategy.


Reporting & Analytics:


Oversee reporting solutions using:


o BEx Queries / Analysis for Office / SAP BO / SAC (where applicable)


• Ensure reporting performance, semantic consistency, and business KPI alignment across domains (FI, CO, SD, MM, Supply Chain).


Migration & Modernization:


Lead BW on HANA / BW/4HANA conversion and migration programs, including:


o Readiness checks and simplification item handling


o Remediation of custom code and data models


o Data volume management and performance validation


• Support S/4HANA transformation programs from an analytics perspective.

Production Support & Governance

• Act as escalation point for production issues, SLA adherence, root cause analysis, and resolution.

• Ensure strong governance around transports (ChaRM), releases, incident/change management, and documentation.


Team & Stakeholder Leadership:


• Mentor and guide SAP BW developers and HANA modelers.

• Work closely with business stakeholders, functional teams, architects, and program managers.

• Contribute to effort estimation, planning, and delivery commitments.

Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success & Operations Associate em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Foundey

Foundey (formerly Uitify) is an embedded product design partner for early-stage SaaS and AI startups based in the United States. We help founders improve product clarity, user experience, and go-to-market execution through senior design thinking combined with fast, high-quality execution.

We partner closely with ambitious startup teams to transform complex ideas into intuitive products, compelling narratives, and scalable digital experiences. Our work sits at the intersection of product strategy, design excellence, and business growth.


THE ROLE

In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for our clients, ensuring they get maximum value

from our compliance solutions while supporting smooth internal operations. You will work at the

intersection of client relationship management, process optimization, and regulatory knowledge —

making this an ideal position for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.


THE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Customer Success
  • Serve as the dedicated point of contact for a portfolio of clients, building trusted long-term

relationships

  • Onboard new clients by guiding them through platform setup, training, and initial compliance

workflows

  • Conduct regular check-ins, business reviews, and health assessments to track client

satisfaction and product adoption

  • Proactively identify at-risk accounts and develop retention strategies in collaboration with

Sales and Product teams

  • Gather and synthesize client feedback to inform product roadmap and service improvements

Operations & Process Support

  • Support internal operational processes including workflow documentation, project tracking,

and reporting

  • Maintain accurate client data and interaction records in the CRM system (Notion)
  • Assist in the development and refinement of SOPs, playbooks, and knowledge base content
  • Monitor deliverables and deadlines on behalf of clients, flagging risks proactively.

  • Develop a working understanding of the regulatory frameworks relevant to our clients (e.g.,

Annual filings ect.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or operations
  • Exceptional written and verbal (English) communication skills with the ability to explain

complex concepts clearly

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and client accounts

simultaneously

  • Proficiency with Notion, Google and project management platforms is a plus
  • A proactive, problem-solving mindset with a high attention to detail

Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will play a key role in shaping how an ambitious startup design partner communicates its value to the world.

Today, our biggest bottleneck is not delivery — it’s clarity. We are looking for someone who can help sharpen our story, accelerate our sales process, and build unmistakable positioning in a highly competitive market.

  • You’ll work directly with founders, influence business strategy, and have meaningful ownership over how Foundey grows, communicates, and wins clients.

title: Customer Support Representative, Level 1
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Support Representative, Level 1 em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Customer Support Representative to be on the front lines by answering questions and troubleshooting technical problems. You will assist customers with JoVE’s products and also guide clients through any technical issue they might encounter. If you are an energetic self-starter problem solver with a basic technical background and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you. The Support Team here at JoVE is providing support not only to external customers but also to internal JoVE employees on a 24x7 basis.


Responsibilities:


  • Manage large amounts of incoming tickets.
  • Provide support to answer inquiries on products.
  • Accept and handle technical requests.
  • Triage tickets to the other teams.
  • Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies.
  • Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools.
  • Build sustainable relationships and trust with customers through open communication.
  • Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution.
  • Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents.
  • Take the extra mile to engage customers.
  • Performs other specific duties or assignments as directed by Team Manager.


Skills And Qualifications:


  • A Bachelor’s degree completed
  • 2+ years of demonstrable experience in customer support or customer success roles
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, verbal and written, are required to effectively and accurately communicate in English.
  • Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical personnel in a clear and easy fashion.
  • Basic understanding of KPIs and Metrics.
  • Attention to detail is key to this position.
  • Must be able to accommodate flexible work schedules based on business needs.
  • Must have technical/diagnostic ability along with analytical ability to diagnose problems above basics, and basic mechanical skills.
  • Proficient with ticketing tools ( Zendesk, Jira, Salesforce).


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Head de MKT e Lançamentos Infoprodutos - Francês fluente
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head de MKT e Lançamentos Infoprodutos - Francês fluente em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Head de MKT de Lançamentos de Infoprodutos

Francês Fluente | Remoto | Empresa Francesa

Remuneração: a combinar


## Sobre a oportunidade


Somos uma empresa francesa especializada em programas online de saúde e bem-estar feminino, com forte atuação junto a mulheres acima dos 40 anos.


Estamos em uma fase acelerada de crescimento e buscamos uma pessoa capaz de assumir progressivamente a liderança operacional dos nossos lançamentos e campanhas de marketing.


Importante: esta não é uma vaga para um Head de Marketing corporativo ou institucional.

Buscamos alguém que conheça profundamente o mercado de infoprodutos e tenha experiência prática na construção, execução e otimização de lançamentos digitais.


Precisamos de alguém que saiba colocar a mão na massa, criar campanhas, revisar copy, orientar criativos, estruturar páginas, acompanhar métricas e liderar a execução de lançamentos do início ao fim.


## O desafio da posição


Hoje o fundador ainda atua diretamente como principal estrategista de lançamentos, principal copywriter e responsável pela construção das campanhas.


O objetivo desta contratação é trazer para o time alguém com repertório suficiente para assumir grande parte dessa operação, reduzindo gargalos e aumentando a autonomia da equipe.


## Principais responsabilidades


• Planejar e coordenar lançamentos digitais de ponta a ponta

• Estruturar campanhas de aquisição, nutrição, conversão e vendas

• Construir cronogramas de lançamento e garantir sua execução

• Coordenar entregas entre equipe interna, agências e parceiros

• Criar ou revisar páginas de captura, páginas de vendas e campanhas promocionais

• Desenvolver narrativas e posicionamentos para campanhas de lançamento

• Criar ou revisar sequências de e-mails, anúncios e materiais promocionais

• Orientar a produção de criativos e conteúdos utilizados nos lançamentos

• Identificar gargalos de conversão ao longo do funil

• Propor melhorias em páginas, criativos, ofertas e campanhas

• Analisar indicadores e tomar decisões baseadas em dados

• Desenvolver novos testes e hipóteses de crescimento

• Liderar taticamente a equipe de marketing

• Coordenar o trabalho do analista de marketing, social media, editores, agência de tráfego e agência de dados

• Garantir alinhamento entre estratégia e execução

• Estruturar processos, playbooks e rotinas operacionais


## Requisitos obrigatórios


• Francês fluente (oral e escrito) - este profissional irá liderar um time em francês

• Experiência comprovada com lançamentos de infoprodutos

• Experiência construindo campanhas de lançamento do início ao fim

• Experiência com copywriting

• Experiência revisando ou criando páginas, anúncios e campanhas

• Conhecimento avançado de funis de vendas e conversão

• Capacidade de analisar métricas e transformar dados em decisões

• Experiência liderando projetos ou equipes de marketing

• Capacidade de atuar com autonomia em ambiente remoto


## Diferenciais


• Histórico de participação em lançamentos de múltiplos seis ou sete dígitos

• Experiência com saúde, bem-estar, menopausa, nutrição ou longevidade

• Experiência com YouTube Ads e Google Ads

• Familiaridade com Inteligência Artificial aplicada ao marketing

• Vivência em operações internacionais ou mercado francófono


## Perfil ideal


• Perfil altamente executor

• Forte senso de responsabilidade

• Capacidade de alternar entre estratégia e operação

• Facilidade para liderar pessoas sem perder a capacidade de execução

• Boa capacidade analítica

• Interesse por crescimento contínuo e melhoria de performance


Mais do que um gestor, buscamos alguém capaz de construir campanhas, melhorar lançamentos e se tornar uma referência técnica dentro da operação de marketing.


Interessados devem enviar currículo para com o assunto Head Francês

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Specialist AI Engineer / Builder (LLM & Healthcare) | Remote Job em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Challenge

Every year, the healthcare industry loses billions due to billing failures. We are building the missing link that closes this gap with AI.

We are growing fast, with real operations, active customers, and new partners in the pipeline. We are looking for a builder who wants to help turn our current product into a platform with global scale.


Why This Role Might Be for You

Here, autonomy, ownership, and initiative are part of the daily routine. We are not looking for someone who already knows everything. Not knowing is part of the process. What matters to us is investigative curiosity, strong execution, and a genuine desire to learn.

You will work across both execution and strategy: from writing code to helping shape product and technical decisions. This is a role for someone who can propose new models, spot revenue opportunities, and also dig into data manually when needed to make sure the solution is truly accurate.

Speed, urgency, and attention to detail are essential to how we build.


Key Responsibilities

Your mission will be to help lead the evolution of our AI capabilities.

Today: Execution and Precision

  • Refine and optimize models already in production using AWS Bedrock, continuously improving accuracy and performance.
  • Validate data, rules, and outputs manually when needed. In healthcare, data quality is non-negotiable.
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement fast feedback loops so the system improves continuously.

Tomorrow: Scale and Architecture

  • Help evolve our infrastructure into a robust ecosystem using RAG pipelines and vector databases.
  • Move from a centralized AI solution toward a network of specialized models by context and insurance payer.
  • Contribute to fine-tuning proprietary models using our historical data to create a unique competitive advantage.


What We’re Looking For

  • Investigative curiosity: You want to understand complex medical billing rules and are motivated to master a difficult domain. Healthcare experience is not required.
  • Bias for action: You move fast, take initiative, and understand that speed matters in an early-stage company.
  • Hands-on coding ability: Solid practical experience with Python or Go, plus experience working with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or AWS Bedrock.
  • Builder mindset: You enjoy creating robust systems from scratch and care deeply about precision, reliability, and business impact.


What We Offer

  • Early-stage impact: Be one of the early team members in a fast-growing company and help shape both the architecture and the culture.
  • High-level technical challenge: Work on real business problems using modern generative AI.
  • Strong team: Work with ambitious, high-performing people who care about building something meaningful.
  • Remote flexibility: 100% remote work, open to candidates based in Brazil.
  • Long-term upside: Potential equity participation for people who help build the business with us.
  • Legacy: Your work will leave a real mark on the product, the codebase, and the company’s story.

title: Client Relationship Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Client Relationship Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Owner Relations Specialist (Remote) – Property Management

Compensation: 9am - 7pm Saturday & Sunday $500/month (remote, part-time)

About Us:

We are a fast-growing property management company specializing in short-term rentals. Our focus is on providing seamless, top-quality service to both homeowners and guests. We are seeking a professional, organized, and efficient Owner Relations Specialist to join our remote team.

Position Overview:

The Owner Relations Specialist will be the primary point of contact for our homeowners. You will communicate with property owners, relay information to our internal teams, and ensure that all requests are handled promptly and professionally. This role requires excellent English communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to stay organized in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Act as the main liaison between homeowners and our internal teams
  • Handle homeowner inquiries with professionalism and efficiency
  • Ensure homeowners are updated on property matters and requests are addressed in a timely manner
  • Coordinate with operations, maintenance, and guest communication teams to resolve issues
  • Maintain accurate records of homeowner interactions and follow-ups

Qualifications:

  • Excellent English (both written and spoken)
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive
  • Previous experience in property management, hospitality, or customer relations is a plus
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment

Compensation:

  • $500/month (remote, part-time)

Why Join Us?

  • Work with a growing, dynamic property management company
  • Remote role with a supportive team environment
  • Opportunity to take ownership of a key role in the business

If you are a professional with strong communication skills and a passion for delivering excellent service, we’d love to hear from you!

Application Instructions:

To apply, please:

  • Record a short Loom video (2–3 minutes) introducing yourself and explaining why you’d be a great fit for this role.
  • Send your CV and Loom video link to:

We look forward to meeting professionals who are ready to bring efficiency, organization, and excellent communication to our team!

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Pleno (Foco Microsoft Security & Compliance)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Segurança da Informação Pleno (Foco Microsoft Security & Compliance) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Vaga: Analista de Segurança da Informação Pleno (Foco Microsoft Security & Compliance)

Modelo: CLT | Remoto


Buscamos um Analista de Segurança da Informação Pleno com forte domínio do ecossistema Microsoft, capaz de atuar de ponta a ponta na implementação, administração e evolução de controles de segurança e conformidade no Microsoft 365.

Essa posição exige perfil analítico, visão de negócio e atuação proativa na prevenção de riscos, além de capacidade de estruturar e evoluir controles de proteção de dados e monitoramento de ameaças.


Responsabilidades

  • Implementar, administrar e evoluir soluções de segurança e conformidade Microsoft (Purview, DLP, MIP, Insider Risk e Defender for Cloud Apps)
  • Mapear processos e identificar informações críticas para definição de políticas de proteção
  • Atuar junto às áreas de negócio na adoção e sustentação de controles de segurança
  • Monitorar eventos, investigar alertas e conduzir análises de incidentes no ambiente Microsoft 365
  • Ajustar políticas, reduzir falsos positivos e promover melhoria contínua dos controles
  • Apoiar investigações de incidentes relacionados à proteção de dados e identidade
  • Produzir relatórios de risco, conformidade e evolução do ambiente
  • Garantir aderência a requisitos regulatórios como LGPD e políticas internas


Requisitos

  • Superior ou pós graduação completo em áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prática com Microsoft 365 Security & Compliance
  • Domínio de Microsoft Purview (DLP, MIP, Compliance e Insider Risk)
  • Experiência com Defender for Cloud Apps (CASB)
  • Conhecimento em Defender for Endpoint, Identity e Office 365
  • Experiência com classificação, rotulagem e políticas DLP (Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive e endpoints)
  • Vivência com investigação e resposta a incidentes de segurança
  • Conhecimento em KQL para análise de logs
  • Noções de automação (Shell Script ou Python)
  • Experiência com SIEM (Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic, Wazuh, Splunk, entre outros)
  • Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio em controles técnicos


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com gestão de identidade e acessos (IAM)


Certificações obrigatórias (Grupo 1), 1 dessas:

  • SC-900 — Microsoft Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals
  • SC-200 — Microsoft Security Operations Analyst
  • SC-400 — Microsoft Information Protection Administrator


Certificações obrigatórias (Grupo 2), 1 dessas:

  • CompTIA Security+ ou equivalente.
  • CCNA Security+ ou equivalente.
  • CEH Certified Ethical Hacker
  • OSCP Offensive Security Certified Professional.
  • Check Point Certified Security Administrator (CCSA) ou equivalente.
  • Certificação em administração de solução de em Endpoint ou EDR.
  • F5 BIG-IP Certified Administrator, F5 BIG-IP ASM
  • Certified Technical Specialist ou F5 BIG-IP LTM
  • Certified Technical Specialist.
  • Certificação em administração de solução DDoS.
  • Microsoft 365 Certified: Security Administrator Associate, Microsoft Certified.
  • EXIN Information Security Management Professional based on ISO/IEC 27001.
  • ISO 27001:2013 Auditor Interno.
  • ISO 27001:2022 Auditor Líder.
  • ISO 27001:2022 Lead Implementer.

title: Junior Writer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Junior Writer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Junior Writer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM

About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.


Role Overview

As a Junior Writer, you will be responsible for adapting and localizing English content into portuguese - culturally relevant versions, ensuring narrative consistency, emotional depth, and audience engagement. You will work closely with editorial, production, and AI teams to refine scripts, monitor performance, and enhance content quality across the platform.


Key Responsibilities

1. Content Development & Adaptation

  • Review English show materials (audio/scripts) and prepare localization sheets and concept notes with strong cultural adaptation.
  • Adapt scripts using designated GenAI tools, ensuring proper structuring, tone, and inclusion of emotion tags where required.
  • Review and refine AI-generated translations to ensure alignment with editorial standards, cultural nuances, and narrative integrity.
  • Incorporate editorial and technical feedback to revise and deliver high-quality, polished scripts.
  • Deliver ~300 localized and AI-adapted scripts per month, adhering to timelines and quality benchmarks.


2. Quality Reviews & Continuous Improvement

  • Review published audio episodes and provide structured feedback on AI-generated adaptations.
  • Identify recurring issues in translation, tone, or storytelling and recommend improvements.
  • Analyze user comments and feedback to enhance content quality and relevance.


3. Production Support & Quality Assurance

  • Suggest suitable voice-over artists based on character and project requirements
  • Ensure produced content aligns with creative intent and quality standards
  • Conduct quality checks on production samples and provide actionable feedback to ensure “first-time-right” output.


4. Promotion Support

  • Develop concepts and draft scripts for promotional content (10–60 minutes) aligned with series positioning and storytelling goals


5. AI-Driven Editorial Innovation & Tool Adoption

  • Demonstrate hands-on usage of AI tools to enhance editorial workflows, script development, research, adaptation, and content optimization.
  • Apply strong editorial judgment while leveraging GenAI tools to ensure narrative quality, factual consistency, cultural sensitivity, and platform standards.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, or related
  • Strong storytelling skills with an understanding of narrative structure, character development, and pacing.
  • Familiarity with AI-based writing or content adaptation tools is preferred
  • Experience in content localization, translation review, or scriptwriting is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain consistency across high-volume deliverables.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret user data and feedback.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced content production environment.

title: SAP Consultant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para SAP Consultant em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contractor (PJ)

Rate - 25 - 40hr USD - depending on experience


Must Haves

· 7+ years of experience as an SAP Functional Consultant / Business Partner (SAP R/3 is what they are migrating to)

· Strong expertise across FICO (Finance ), MM (Procurement ), and WM (Warehouse Management)

· Experience supporting manufacturing environments, ideally in medical device, pharma, or other regulated industries

· Proven experience in ERP transformations, migrations, or legacy system replacements

· Strong background in business process redesign, solution design, and requirements gathering

· Experience working closely with technical teams (ABAP, integrations, etc.)

· Ability to engage stakeholders across plant operations, supply chain, and finance teams


Overview

We are seeking an experienced SAP Functional Business Partner to support the transition from legacy ERP systems to SAP R/3 across multiple medical device manufacturing sites.

This role is highly business-facing and consultative, focused on partnering with site stakeholders to understand current processes, drive standardization, and design future-state SAP solutions. The individual will act as a bridge between manufacturing operations, business teams, and IT, providing functional direction to technical teams throughout the transformation.

This is not a hands-on configuration role—it is focused on process design, solution definition, and stakeholder partnership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a business partner to manufacturing sites, including supply chain and IT teams
  • Support the transition from legacy ERP systems to SAP R/3, ensuring alignment to business and operational needs
  • Lead current-state assessments and future-state process design across plant operations
  • Facilitate workshops and discovery sessions to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for standardization
  • Define SAP-aligned solutions that meet both business requirements and regulatory considerations
  • Translate business requirements into clear functional specifications for technical (ABAP/integration) teams
  • Provide ongoing guidance to technical teams during solution design and build phases
  • Ensure alignment across Finance (FICO), Procurement (MM), and Warehouse Management (WM) processes
  • Support testing, validation, and deployment activities, particularly within regulated manufacturing environments
  • Drive adoption of best practices and simplified, standardized processes across sites
